blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Clinical Question Answering (QA) underpins Clinical Intelligent Decision Support Systems, but progress is severely limited for low-resource languages such as Indonesian by the absence of public domain-specific data. We introduce IndoNutriQA, an expert-curated Indonesian clinical QA benchmark of 911 question-answer pairs built from real clinical-nutrition reports. Rather than a large-scale training corpus, it is positioned as a high-quality evaluation resource: every pair is grounded in a clinically relevant context, enriched with structured metadata (anthropometric assessment, medical diagnosis, document provenance, chunk segmentation). Eight standardised question types following the Nutrition Care Process (NCP), including the Problem, Etiology, Sign and Symptom (PES) diagnosis statement, are answered for every report, which was written by a graduate-level dietetic intern, by one of three nutritionists. Answers are free-form clinical prose rather than extractive spans, and an expert validation study finds 6-10% of reference answers contestable. The dataset supports generative, extractive and retrieval-augmented QA as well as zero- and few-shot LLM evaluation. We report fine-tuned baselines (IndoBERT variants, mT5, RAG) with 5-fold cross-validation, learning curves and bootstrap 95% confidence intervals, and benchmark eight contemporary LLMs zero- and five-shot. We further calibrate our LLM-as-judge rubric against three expert raters (one RD, two nutritionists), finding it human-comparable on factuality and completeness but unreliable on clinical safety, and a human error analysis shows it misses unsupported content that the raters identify. IndoNutriQA is released to foster research in Indonesian clinical NLP and nutritional decision support.
blocks.zh: 临床问答(QA)支撑了临床智能决策支持系统,但由于缺乏公共领域特定数据,印尼语等低资源语言的进展受到严重限制. 我们介绍IndoNutriQA,这是根据真实的临床营养状况报告构建的911个问答对印尼临床QA的专家测试基准. 与其说是大规模的培训大纲,不如说是高质量的评价资源:每对评价都以临床相关背景为基础,以结构化的元数据(人体测量评估、医学诊断、文件出处、块块分割)为基础。 营养护理进程之后的8个标准化问题类型,包括问题、胚胎学、征兆学和症状学诊断说明,每份报告都得到回答,由3名营养学家之一的研究生一级营养实习生撰写。 答案是自由形式的临床传言而不是采掘跨度,专家论证研究发现6-10%的参考答案有争议. 该数据集支持基因、采掘和检索强化的质量保证以及零镜头和几镜头LLM评价。 我们报告微调基线(IndoBERT变体,mT5,RAG),有5倍的交叉验证,学习曲线和95%的置信间隔,以及8个当代LLMs零和5发的基准. 我们进一步校准我们的LLM-as-judge语句与3位专家测评员(一位RD,两位营养学家)的对比,发现它与事实和完整性相比,但对于临床安全来说并不可靠,而一项人为误差分析显示它错过了测评员认定的不支持的内容. IndoNutriQA的发布是为了促进印度尼西亚临床NLP的研究和营养决策支持.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Clinical Question Answering (QA) is a core component of Clinical Intelligent Decision Support Systems (CIDSS), enabling efficient access to relevant medical information from unstructured clinical text Demner-Fushman and Lin (2007) ; Mutabazi et al. (2021) . Recent progress in QA has been driven by large-scale benchmarks in both open-domain and biomedical settings, including SQuAD Rajpurkar et al. (2016) , Natural Questions Kwiatkowski et al. (2019) , TyDiQA Clark et al. (2020) , as well as domain-specific resources such as BioASQ Tsatsaronis et al. (2015) , PubMedQA Jin et al. (2019) , and MedQA Jin et al. (2021) . However, existing clinical QA benchmarks degrade when applied to low-resource languages, nutrition subdomains, and localized clinical practices Clark et al. (2020) ; Jin et al. (2019) .
blocks.zh: 临床问询(QA)是临床智能决策支持系统(CIDSS)的核心组成部分,能够从无结构的临床文本Demner-Fushman和Lin(2007年);Mutabazi等人(2021年)中高效获取相关医疗信息. 最近,在开放领域和生物医学背景下,包括SQuAD Rajpurkar等人(2016年)、Natural Quatkowski等人(2019年)、TyDiQA在内的大规模基准推动了质量保证方面的进展。 Clark等人(2020年),以及BioASQ Tsassaronis等人(2015年),PubMedQA Jin等人(2019年),以及MedQA Jin等人(2021年)等特定域资源. 然而,现有的临床质量评估基准在应用于低资源语言,营养亚域,以及本地化临床实践Clark等人(2020年)时会退化;Jin等人(2019年).

blocks.en: In Indonesian healthcare contexts, clinical nutrition reports play an important role in medical decision making, integrating anthropometric assessments, medical diagnoses, and narrative clinical information. Supporting QA over such documents requires datasets that capture domain-specific terminology and reasoning patterns. However, to date, no publicly available Indonesian clinical QA dataset has been specifically designed for nutritional and medical decision support.
blocks.zh: 在印度尼西亚保健方面,临床营养报告在医疗决策、人体测量评估、医疗诊断和叙事临床信息方面发挥着重要作用。 在这类文档上支持质量保证需要能够捕捉特定域的术语和推理模式的数据集. 然而,迄今为止,没有为营养和医疗决策支助专门设计公开的印度尼西亚临床质量保证数据集。

blocks.en: To address this gap, IndoNutriQA is introduced, a novel Indonesian clinical QA dataset constructed from real-world clinical nutrition reports. IndoNutriQA consists of expert-authored question-answer pairs grounded in clinically relevant contexts and enriched with structured metadata, including document provenance, chunk indices, anthropometric assessments, and medical diagnoses. The dataset supports extractive, generative, and retrieval-augmented QA paradigms.
blocks.zh: 为了弥补这一差距,引入了IndoNutriQA,根据现实世界临床营养报告构建的印度尼西亚临床QA新数据集. IndoNutriQA由专家撰写的、基于临床相关背景的对答,并丰富了结构化元数据,包括文件来源、块指数、人体测量评估和医学诊断。 该数据集支持采掘,基因化,以及检索强化的QA范式.

blocks.en: Baseline experiments with state-of-the-art neural QA models establish reference performance and expose challenges specific to Indonesian nutrition-focused clinical QA, such as domain terminology and numerical reasoning over anthropometric data. We deliberately position IndoNutriQA as an evaluation benchmark rather than a training corpus: annotating clinical text with experts is intrinsically expensive, so a small, expert-authored test set is the operative bottleneck for measuring progress here. The protocol of Section 6 makes this concrete through cross-validation with bootstrap confidence intervals, a learning curve over training-split fractions, and zero- and few-shot LLM evaluation that needs no in-domain training data. Our contributions are: (i) the first public Indonesian clinical-nutrition QA benchmark , 911 911 pairs over 120 120 real multi-hospital reports, anonymised at patient and institution level; (ii) an expert-authored annotation design applying eight standardised questions from the Nutrition Care Process (NCP) and its Problem, Etiology, Sign and Symptom (PES) statement format uniformly to every report, each answer written by one of three nutritionists from reports authored by graduate-level dietetic interns; (iii) reference results for four model families (one RAG configuration) ; (iv) a five-axis evaluation protocol (lexical, semantic, LLM-judge, RAGAS, stratified) with cross-validation, learning curves and bootstrap CIs; and (v) a validation study by three expert raters (one Registered Dietitian, two nutritionists) covering the LLM-judge rubric, reference-answer errors and a human error analysis (Section 6.8 , Appendix E ). IndoNutriQA supports future research in Indonesian clinical NLP, nutrition informatics, and AI-driven clinical decision support.
blocks.zh: 使用最先进的神经QA模型进行基线实验,确定参考性能,并暴露印度尼西亚以营养为重点的临床QA特有的挑战,如域名和数字推理相对于人类测量数据. 我们刻意将IndoNutriQA定位为评估基准而不是培训工具:向专家注释临床文本本质上是昂贵的,因此,一个小型的、由专家撰写的测试集是衡量这方面进展的实际瓶颈。 第6节的规程使这种混凝土通过有靴子置信间隔的交叉验证、一个学习曲线超过训练的碎片、零射和几射的LLM评价,这些不需要域内训练数据。 我们的贡献是:(一) 首个公开的印度尼西亚临床营养质量评估基准,911 911对,120份以上真实的多医院报告,在病人和机构一级匿名;(二) 专家撰写的说明设计,采用营养护理进程及其问题、生态学、征兆和症状(PES)的8个标准问题格式,每份由三名营养学家之一从研究生一级营养实习生编写的报告中作答;(三) 四个模范家庭的参考结果(一个RAG配置);(四) 五轴评价协议(语法、语法、语法、LLM-法官、RAGAS、分层),包括交叉验证、学习曲线和靴子链式CIs;以及(五) 三名专家评分仪(一名注册饮食学家,两名营养学家)进行的验证研究,涵盖LLM法官的Rubridge、参考解答错误和一项人的错误分析(第6.8节,附录E)。 IndoNutriQA支持未来印尼临床NLP的研究,营养信息学,以及AI驱动的临床决策支持.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: General-purpose QA benchmarks such as SQuAD Rajpurkar et al. (2016) , Natural Questions Kwiatkowski et al. (2019) , and the multilingual TyDi QA Clark et al. (2020) (which includes Indonesian) have driven progress on machine reading comprehension but do not target clinical reasoning. Clinical/biomedical QA resources include BioASQ Tsatsaronis et al. (2015) (biomedical semantic indexing over PubMed), PubMedQA Jin et al. (2019) (yes/no/maybe questions from biomedical literature), and MedQA Jin et al. (2021) (medical licensing-exam multiple choice), all of which are English-language and do not target nutrition-focused reasoning over real clinical documentation. Pretrained English biomedical and clinical encoders such as BioBERT Lee et al. (2020) and ClinicalBERT Alsentzer et al. (2019) support such tasks, but we are not aware of comparable Indonesian clinical encoders. Indonesian NLP has matured rapidly through resources such as IndoBERT Wilie et al. (2020) , IndoBART Cahyawijaya et al. (2021) , and the IndoLEM benchmark Koto et al. (2020) , but no publicly available Indonesian clinical or nutrition QA dataset existed prior to IndoNutriQA; prior Indonesian medical-NLP work Aji et al. (2021) ; Vihikan and Trisna (2024) has been limited to general medical-term extraction and classification rather than question answering.
blocks.zh: SQuAD Rajpurkar等人(2016年),Natural Questions Kwiatkowski等人(2019年),以及多语言的TyDi QA Clark等人(2020年)(包括印度尼西亚语)等通用QA基准推动了机器阅读理解方面的进展,但没有针对临床推理. 临床/生物医学QA资源包括BioASQ Tsatsaronis等人(2015年)(PubMed上的生物医学语义索引),PubMedQA Jin等人(2019年)(是/否/可能来自生物医学文献的问题),以及MedQA Jin等人(2021年)(医疗许可-课程多重选择),所有这一切都是英语,并不针对真实临床文献的以营养为重点的推理. BioBERT Lee等人(2020年)和临床BERT等经过培训的英国生物医学和临床编码器 Alsentzer等人(2019年)支持这种任务,但我们不知道印度尼西亚临床编码器具有可比性。 印度尼西亚NLP通过IndoBERT Wilie等人(2020年),IndoBART Cahyawijaya等人(2021年),IndoLEM基准Koto等人(2020年)等资源迅速成熟,但在IndoNutriQA之前没有公开的印度尼西亚临床或营养QA数据集;之前印度尼西亚的医学-NLP工作Aji等人(2021年),Vihikan和Trisna(2024年)仅限于一般医学期提取和分类,而不是质疑答案.

blocks.en: These resources differ in how answers are produced, which matters more than raw size. BioASQ Tsatsaronis et al. (2015) answers are written by biomedical experts; PubMedQA Jin et al. (2019) derives yes/no/maybe labels from abstract conclusions, only 1 1 K of its 273 273 K instances being expert-labelled; MedQA Jin et al. (2021) and MedMCQA Pal et al. (2022) inherit certified answer keys from licensing exams, but the reasoning is exam-style; MedQuAD Abacha and Demner-Fushman (2019) harvests answers from curated NIH pages; and emrQA Pampari et al. (2018) template-generates 400 400 K+ pairs over expert-annotated electronic health records (EHRs), making it large but not individually expert-authored. IndoNutriQA sits at the small-and-fully-curated end: each of its 911 911 answers is written by one of three nutritionists from real reports authored by dietitians-in-training.
blocks.zh: 这些资源在如何生成答案方面有所不同,这不仅仅是原始规模。 BioASQ Tsatsaronis等人(2015年)的回答由生物医学专家撰写;PubMedQA Jin等人. (2019年)从抽象结论中得出是/否/可能标注,其273 273 K例中仅有1 K 被专家标注; MedQA Jin等人(2021年)和 MedMCQA Pal等人。 (2022年)继承许可证考试的认证答案密钥,但推理是考试式的;MedQuAD Abacha和Demner-Fushman(2019年)收录了NIH主页的答案;以及EMrQA Pampari等人(2018年)的模板-基因400,400 K+对比专家附加说明的电子健康记录(EHRs),使其庞大但并非个人专家撰写. 印度语Name QA坐落于小而完全准确的端点:其911911的每个答案都是由三位营养学家之一撰写的,来自实实在在的报告,作者是饮食师在训练中.

blocks.en: QA resources aimed at nutritional or dietary decision support remain scarce: nutrition appears in general medical benchmarks only incidentally, and we are aware of no public QA dataset built around the NCP, anthropometric and biochemical assessment, or diet-prescription reasoning in any language. Outside English the largest resources are Chinese (the MCMLE and TWMLE portions of MedQA Jin et al. (2021) contribute roughly 34 34 K and 14 14 K licensing items), while multilingual open-domain QA such as TyDi QA Clark et al. (2020) includes Indonesian but not clinical text. Indonesian medical NLP has so far been limited to term extraction and classification Aji et al. (2021) ; Vihikan and Trisna (2024) .
blocks.zh: 用于营养或膳食决策支持的质检资源仍然稀缺:营养只是偶然出现在一般的医疗基准中,我们知道没有围绕国家CP、人体测量和生物化学评估或任何语言的饮食处方推理建立公共质检数据集。 在英语之外,最大的资源是中文(MedQA Jin等人(2021年)的MCMLE和TWMLE部分贡献了大约34个34K和14个14K许可证项目),而多语种开放域QA如TyDi QA Clark等人. (2020年)包括印度尼西亚文,但不包括临床文本. 印度尼西亚医学NLP至今仅限于术语提取和分类Aji等人(2021年);Vihikan和Trisna(2024年).

blocks.en: Existing benchmarks each satisfy some of the properties IndoNutriQA targets, but none satisfies all three at once. TyDi QA Clark et al. (2020) covers Indonesian but is open-domain, while every clinical resource above is English or Chinese. No benchmark in any language targets clinical nutrition, despite nutrition being the locus of a distinct reasoning pattern (anthropometric assessment, biochemical interpretation, and prescription arithmetic) that general medical QA does not exercise. MedQA Jin et al. (2021) and MedMCQA Pal et al. (2022) are drawn from licensing exams and PubMedQA Jin et al. (2019) from literature abstracts, so neither requires reasoning over the messy, semi-structured documentation clinicians actually produce; emrQA Pampari et al. (2018) is grounded in real EHRs but is English and template-generated rather than expert-authored. IndoNutriQA is the first resource to occupy the intersection: Indonesian, nutrition-focused, and grounded in authentic clinical reports with every answer written by a nutritionist following NCP/PES documentation guidelines (Table 6 ).
blocks.zh: 现有的基准都满足了IndoNutriQA的一些属性目标,但没有一项同时满足所有三个属性. TyDi QA (英语). Clark等编著. (2020年)覆盖印尼语,但属于开放域,而以上所有临床资源都是英语或中文. 没有任何一种语言的基准以临床营养为目标,尽管营养是一般医学质量评估所没有的明显推理模式(人体测量评估、生化解释和处方算术)的中心。 MedQA Jin等人(2021年)和MedMCQA Pal等人(2022年)从许可证考试中抽取,PubMedQA Jin等人(2019年)则从文献摘要中抽取,因此两者都不要求对实际制作的杂乱,半结构化的文件临床医生进行推理;emrQA Pampari等人(2018年)以真实的EHRs为基础,但都是英语,模板生成而非专家撰写的. 印度语Name QA是第一个占据十字路口的资源:印度尼西亚语,以营养为重点,并基于真实的临床报告,每个答案都是由营养学家根据NCP/PES文件准则撰写的(表6)。

blocks.en: A second distinction concerns the unit of annotation. The benchmarks above pair free-form questions with answers, so question phrasing and answer content vary together. IndoNutriQA instead applies eight standardised questions, drawn directly from the NCP and PES reporting frameworks, uniformly to every patient report. This fixes the question side and confines annotator variation to answer text, which is what makes a 911 911 -pair corpus usable as a controlled evaluation instrument rather than merely a small training set.
blocks.zh: 第二个区别涉及注释单位。 以上基准将自由形式问题配以答案,因此问题措辞和答案内容各有不同. 反之,IndoNutriQA将直接从国家CP和PES报告框架中抽取的八个标准化问题统一适用于每个病人报告。 这使得911-911-pair accoup作为可控评估工具,而不仅仅是一个小型培训集。

blocks.en: 3 Dataset Construction
blocks.zh: 3 数据集建设

blocks.en: 3.1 Data Sources
blocks.zh: 3.1 国家 数据来源

blocks.en: The IndoNutriQA dataset comprises clinical reports and nutritional assessment documents sourced from diverse healthcare facilities across Indonesia. This multi-institution sampling ensures broad coverage of varied hospital settings, anthropometric profiles, medical diagnoses, and nutritional conditions.
blocks.zh: 印度语Name 质量评估数据集包括来自印度尼西亚各地各种保健设施的临床报告和营养评估文件。 这种多机构抽样确保广泛覆盖不同的医院环境、人体测量特征、医疗诊断和营养状况。

blocks.en: All data were de-identified at both patient and institution level before annotation. Indonesian hospitals are not subject to the US Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA), but we adopt its Safe Harbor identifier list as a voluntary de-identification standard: every category of Protected Health Information (PHI) it enumerates, namely names, medical-record and registration numbers, geographic detail, and all dates, is removed and replaced with deterministic placeholders, while the clinically and nutritionally relevant content required for question answering is preserved. The procedure and placeholder scheme are detailed in the Ethics Statement. The source materials are patient assessment reports, nutritional consultation records, and clinical follow-up notes.
blocks.zh: 在作出说明之前,所有数据在病人和机构两级都不再识别。 印度尼西亚医院不受《美国健康保险可携带性和问责法》的约束,但我们采用安全港标识清单作为自愿消除识别标准:它所列举的各类保护健康信息,即姓名、医疗记录和登记号码、地理细节以及所有日期都被删除,代之以决定性占位者,同时保留回答问题所需的临床和营养相关内容。 程序和占位人计划详见道德操守说明。 来源材料是病人评估报告、营养咨询记录和临床后续说明。

blocks.en:
The dataset development was carried out in close collaboration with clinical nutrition experts,
who provided guidance throughout the data collection, annotation, and validation processes. The documents were derived from complete clinical rotation reports prepared by graduate-level dietetic interns during clinical nutrition rotations. These reports include detailed case descriptions, anthropometric measurements, biochemical parameters, and dietary management plans, which served as the foundation for generating clinically grounded question–answer pairs. The question–answer pairs were written by three nutritionists, and a stratified sample was later validated by one Registered Dietitian (RD) and two of those nutritionists (Section 4 ).
blocks.zh:
数据集开发是与临床营养专家密切合作进行的,
他们在整个数据收集、注释和验证过程中提供指导。 这些文件来自临床营养轮换期间由研究生级饮食实习人员编写的完整的临床轮换报告。 这些报告包括详细的病例描述、人体测量、生化参数和饮食管理计划,这些计划是产生临床问题答案的基础。 回答对是由三位营养学家撰写的,一个分层样本后来被一位注册饮食学家(RD)和其中两位营养学家(第4节)验证。

blocks.en: Unlike fully synthetic datasets, IndoNutriQA is grounded in authentic clinical documentation, with answers written by nutritionists. This approach ensures that the dataset reflects the complexity, variability, and contextual reasoning of real-world clinical nutrition practice, providing a reliable foundation for research in Indonesian clinical question answering and medical decision support.
blocks.zh: 与全合成数据集不同,IndoNutriQA基于真实的临床文献,由营养学家撰写答案. 这种方法确保数据集反映现实世界临床营养实践的复杂性,可变性和背景推理,为印度尼西亚临床问题回答和医疗决策支持的研究提供了可靠的基础.

blocks.en: 3.2 Dataset Schema and Pipeline
blocks.zh: 3.2 数据集Schema和管道

blocks.en: Each entry in IndoNutriQA contains: a unique id , the source report_title and file , the page_number and chunk_index that locate the answer in the report, structured anthropometric_assessment and medical_diagnosis metadata, the context (the chunk text), the question , and the ground-truth answer . An example instance appears in Appendix J .
blocks.zh: IndoNutri 中的每个条目 QA 包含: 独有的 id , 源报告_ title and file , 查找报告答案的 page_ number and block_index, 结构化的 人类测量_ 评估 和医学_ 诊断元数据, 上下文( 块文本), 问题, 和地面- 真相答案 。 一个实例见附录J。

blocks.en: Although IndoNutriQA uses a SQuAD-style container with an answer_start offset, its answers are abstractive: annotators authored clinical prose rather than selecting text from the chunk. Only 8.7 % 8.7\% of answers occur verbatim in their context ( 31.2 % 31.2\% ignoring all whitespace); the median answer is 30 30 words and 38 % 38\% exceed 50 50 . The answer_start field marks the best-matching passage (Appendix A ), not a verbatim span. This is the main reason the extractive baselines trail the prompted LLMs (Section 6.2 ): for most items no exactly correct span exists.
blocks.zh: 虽然印努特里语Name QA使用一个SQuAD风格的容器,并带有一个答案_sart 偏移,它的答案是抽象的: 注释者是临床传言作者,而不是从块中选择文本. 只有8.7%的8.7%的回答在上下文中逐字出现(31.2%的31.2 %忽略了所有白空间);中位答案为30个30字,38%的38 % 超过50个。 答案_启动字段标记了最匹配的通道(Appendix A ),而不是逐字记录。 这是采掘基线跟踪所触发的有限责任措施(第6.2节)的主要原因:对于大多数项目来说,不存在完全正确的跨度。

blocks.en: The construction pipeline has five stages: (i) collection of clinical-nutrition reports in PDF/plain-text Indonesian from collaborating hospitals; (ii) personally identifiable information (PII) anonymization and chunking; (iii) expert annotation of anthropometric and diagnostic metadata; (iv) QA construction by authoring answers to a fixed set of eight standardized clinical-nutrition questions (Appendix I ); and (v) algorithmic context-pairing that maps each authored answer to its source chunk (full annotation, validation, and matching details are in Appendix A ). The eight standardized questions are applied uniformly to every patient report, so the unit of annotation is (report, answer-to-fixed-question) rather than free-form (question, answer); this constrains inter-annotator variation to answer text rather than question phrasing. The fixed question set measures competence on eight NCP/PES steps, not open-ended clinical QA (see Limitations).
blocks.zh: 建造管道分五个阶段:(一) 从合作医院收集印度尼西亚语PDF/Plain-text中的临床营养报告;(二) 个人可识别信息(PII)匿名和块化;(三) 人类测量和诊断元数据的专家注释;(四) 通过对一套固定的8个标准化临床营养问题的答复(附录一) 质量评估的构建(附录一);(五) 绘制每个作者对源块的答复的算法背景描述(完整的注释、验证和匹配细节见附录A)。 八个标准化问题统一应用于每份病人报告,因此注释的单位是(报告,回答固定的问题)而不是自由形式(问题,回答);这制约了注释者之间的变异,以回答文本,而不是问题措辞. 固定问题设定了8个NCP/PES步骤的计量能力,而不是开放式的临床质量保证(见限制)。

blocks.en: 4 Annotation Protocol and Agreement
blocks.zh: 4 注释议定书和协定

blocks.en: IndoNutriQA’s reference answers are written by three nutritionists, one per report, rather than by a larger panel with parallel annotation. That design decision governs how the benchmark should be read, so we report the protocol and its agreement properties in the body; Appendix A adds procedural detail.
blocks.zh: IndoNutriQA的参考答案由三位营养学家撰写,每份报告一位,而不是由一个具有平行注释的更大的小组撰写. 这一设计决定规定了如何阅读基准,因此我们报告协议及其协议在正文中的属性;附录A增加了程序细节。

blocks.en: The 120 120 reports were written by 89 89 distinct graduate-level dietetic interns ( 67 67 contributed one report, 13 13 two, and 9 9 three) as clinical rotation deliverables of a dietetic internship, each supervised by a lecturer of the Faculty of Health Sciences, Universitas Brawijaya. The eight answers of Table 1 for every report were then written by three nutritionists, each covering a different set of reports, so every (report, question) pair has exactly one author. Answers are free text (median 30 30 words) and follow the NCP/PES documentation standard as annotation guideline. A stratified 50 50 -unit sample of model outputs was later re-scored by three expert raters, one RD who took no part in writing the answers and two of the three nutritionists, for the calibration study of Appendix E .
blocks.zh: 这120份报告由89名89名不同的研究生学位实习生撰写(67名67人提交了一份报告,13名13名2名,9名9名3名),作为博士学位实习生的临床轮调交付品,每份都由布拉维贾亚大学卫生学院的一名讲师监督。 然后,表1对每份报告的8个答案由3名营养学家写成,每一份都涵盖一套不同的报告,因此每对(报告、问题)都有一位作者。 答复是免费文本(中间30个字),并遵循国家CP/PES文件标准作为注释准则。 3名专家评分员(1名没有参与写出答案的RD)和3名营养学家中的2名重新评分,对附录E进行了校准研究。

blocks.en: Three mechanisms limit variance, and one limitation remains. (i) The question side is fixed: all three nutritionists answer the same eight questions (Table 1 ) for every report, so no question-authoring variance exists. (ii) The rubric is external to the dataset: each question maps one-to-one onto an NCP section, and Question 4 must be written in PES form with its three components in the prescribed order, so annotators work to a national clinical-documentation standard that predates this dataset rather than to a guideline we authored. (iii) The author pool is small, so there are only three writing styles to account for. The limitation is that each nutritionist wrote the answers for different reports, so author effects cannot be separated from report effects.
blocks.zh: 三种机制限制差异,还有一种限制。 (一)问题方是固定的:所有三个营养学家对每份报告都回答相同的八个问题(表1),因此不存在问题作者差异. (二)标点在数据集之外:每个题点将1对1映射到NCP部分,第4题必须按规定的顺序以PES形式写出其三个组成部分,因此,注释者按照一个比本数据集更早的国家临床记录标准而不是我们所撰写的准则工作. (三)作者池小,所以只有三种写作风格可以说明. 限制在于每个营养学家为不同的报告写了答案,因此作者效应不能与报告效应分开.

blocks.en: Each report was answered by a single nutritionist, so the same (report, question) pair is never annotated in parallel and a conventional inter-annotator κ \kappa over the references is not defined for this release. We state this plainly because the alternative, reporting the rater agreement figures below as though they were dataset κ \kappa , would misrepresent what was measured. Three agreement-relevant quantities are available.
blocks.zh: 每份报告都由一个营养学家回答,因此,同一对(报告、问题)从未平行地附加说明,也没有为本版界定一个常规的注释员之间的“ob-kappa”。 我们直言不讳地说,因为另一种办法是,在下面报告评分协议数字,把它们当作是“\kappa”的数据集,这样会歪曲所衡量的情况。 有三个与协定相关的数量。

blocks.en: (a) Gold-answer error rate. The three raters could flag any audited unit whose reference answer they judged incorrect or contestable. Three of 50 50 units were flagged ( 6 % 6\% ), one by two raters independently; counting units where a rater criticised the reference in free text without ticking the flag raises this to five ( 10 % 10\% ). The disputes are concrete rather than matters of clinical taste: macronutrient percentages not summing to 100 % 100\% , a mid-upper-arm-circumference cut-off, a neonatal protein prescription. This is a direct estimate of reference error and the figure users of the benchmark should carry: on this sample roughly one item in ten is contestable. The flagged items are released so they can be excluded or re-adjudicated.
blocks.zh: (a) 黄金答错率。 三个评级人可以标出任何被审计单位的参考答案,他们判断错误或有争议. 50个单位中有3个被标注(6% 6 QQ),一个是两个评分员独立标注;一个评分员在免费文本中批评引用时不打勾标注的单位将标注增加到5个(10% 10 QQ)。 争议是具体的,而不是临床品味的问题:宏观营养百分比没有与100%的100===相融合,是中上臂-循环切除,是新生儿蛋白质处方. 这是对参考误差的直接估计,基准数字用户应携带:在这个样本中,大约十分之一的项目是有争议的。 标有标记的物品被放出,以便可以排除或重新判断.

blocks.en: (b) Expert-to-expert agreement on identical items. The same three raters re-scored all 50 50 units on a 1 1 – 5 5 rubric. Quadratic-weighted Cohen’s κ \kappa for the reference rater pair is 0.780 0.780 on factuality and 0.752 0.752 on completeness (Krippendorff ordinal α = 0.592 \alpha=0.592 and 0.712 0.712 across all three raters), but only 0.160 0.160 on clinical safety ( α = 0.250 \alpha=0.250 ), where the three raters’ mean scores span 1.72 1.72 rubric points. Expert agreement in this domain is therefore substantial on verifiable content and effectively absent on safety judgement. That is a ceiling on what any annotation protocol or automatic metric can be expected to reproduce, and it is why we report the safety dimension as unvalidated throughout (Section 6.8 , Appendix E ).
blocks.zh: (b) 关于相同项目的专家对专家协定。 同三名评分员在11比5 5的分数上重新评分了所有50个单位. Quadratic加权Cohen's $\kappa的参考率对事实性为0.780 0.780,完整性为0.752 0.752 0.752(Krippendorff ordinal α = 0.592\alpha = 0.592和 0.712 0.712),但临床安全性为0.160 0.160(α = 0.250\alpha = 0.250),其中三个评分的分值为1.72 1.72 卢布。 因此,这一领域的专家协议对于可核查的内容是实质性的,对于安全判断则实际上不存在。 这是任何注解协议或自动计量标准可以预期复制的上限,也是为什么我们报告整个安全层面没有经过验证(第6.8节,附录E)。

blocks.en: (c) Independence. Two of the three raters also wrote references, so the audit of reference answers is not fully independent: only the RD took no part in writing them. We therefore read the 6 6 – 10 % 10\% as an estimate by raters who are not all external to the dataset.
blocks.zh: (c) 独立性。 三个评分中有两个还写了参考,因此对参考答案的审计并不完全独立:只有RD没有参与编写. 因此,我们把6 6 — — 10 % — — 10 — — 理解为不是所有数据集外的评级人的估计。

blocks.en: The context field for each (report, question, answer) triple is algorithmically located from the source report after answer authoring using a six-stage match (exact, case-insensitive, whitespace-normalized, punctuation-stripped, fragment-matched) on the chunked report. We obtain a verified character-level answer_start for 823 823 of 911 911 pairs ( 90.3 % 90.3\% ); the remaining 88 88 pairs are released with a chunk-level pointer but without a character offset and are flagged in the released metadata. Full details (per-pair validation procedure, subjectivity mitigation, and the six-stage matching algorithm) are in Appendix A .
blocks.zh: 每个(报告,问题,答案)三重的上下文字段,在使用六级匹配(精确,对大小写不敏感,白空-常态,点缀-截面,片段匹配)的答案作者后,从源报告算法上找到. 我们为823 823对911对911(90.3%的90.3)获得一个经核实的字符级答案_启动;其余88对88对以块级指针释放,但没有字符抵消,并在发布的元数据中标出。 全部细节(每页验证程序,主观减缓,以及六级匹配算法)载于附录A.

blocks.en: 5 Dataset Characteristics
blocks.zh: 5 数据集特征

blocks.en: 5.1 Dataset Statistics and Domain Coverage
blocks.zh: 5.1 数据集统计和范围

blocks.en: IndoNutriQA contains 911 911 question–answer pairs from 120 120 clinical-nutrition reports, covering 128 128 unique medical diagnoses. Questions average 8.32 8.32 tokens, answers 70.66 70.66 tokens, and contexts 131.28 131.28 tokens, with 2.60 2.60 chunks per report (Table 3 , Appendix A.1 ). The reports span the disease categories common in Indonesian inpatient nutrition practice. Each report is assigned one dominant category, so the distribution partitions the corpus: respiratory is largest at 28.33 % 28.33\% of the 120 120 reports, followed by infectious ( 17.50 % 17.50\% ), gastrointestinal ( 12.50 % 12.50\% ), nutrition/growth ( 10.83 % 10.83\% ), neurologic ( 10.00 % 10.00\% ), and cardiac and hematologic/oncologic ( 8.33 % 8.33\% each), with renal/urologic and ENT each below 1 % 1\% (Table 18 ). The per-pair distribution tracks the per-report one closely (respiratory 29.97 % 29.97\% , infectious 17.23 % 17.23\% ), so no category is inflated by reports contributing unusually many pairs. Respiratory prominence matches Indonesian hospital epidemiology and its known co-occurrence with nutritional risk Kementerian Kesehatan Republik Indonesia (2019) ; Oktaria et al. (2017) . The mix is naturally imbalanced rather than synthetically balanced, but no category exceeds 30 % 30\% ; Section 6.7 tests whether the imbalance harms generalisation, and Appendix H gives the treemap.

blocks.en: The population profile is clinically realistic: age concentrates in early childhood but extends into adolescence and adulthood, the sex split is 58.4 % 58.4\% male / 41.6 % 41.6\% female, weight-vs-height shows the expected positive correlation with wider dispersion at older ages, and mid-upper arm circumference clusters around screening thresholds. Syntactic divergence between predicted and reference answers (token-level normalised edit distance) is bimodal, with one mode near zero for near-verbatim correct predictions and a second spike at maximum divergence for empty or unrelated outputs, which motivates the multi-metric protocol of Section 6 . Per-axis figures are in Appendix H .

blocks.en: 5.3 Comparison with Existing Medical QA Datasets
blocks.zh: 5.3 与现有医疗质量保证数据集的比较

blocks.en: IndoNutriQA differs from existing medical QA benchmarks on three axes at once: Indonesian language, clinical-nutrition domain, and grounding in authentic clinical reports rather than exam questions or literature abstracts (Section 2 , Table 6 ). Appendix Table 7 compares it side by side with MedQA, MedMCQA, PubMedQA, emrQA, MedQuAD, and MedExQA across language, domain, sample count, question and answer type, source, and length. Its 911 911 pairs are smaller than the largest English benchmarks (emrQA exceeds 400 400 K) but are written by nutritionists from authentic Indonesian inpatient nutrition reports.

blocks.en: 6 Experiments
blocks.zh: 6 实验

blocks.en: We evaluate IndoNutriQA along five axes, each with its own subsection below: aggregate model performance (Section 6.2 ), a dedicated LLM evaluation (Section 6.3 ), statistical robustness (Section 6.4 ), semantic and clinical-rubric metrics beyond lexical overlap (Section 6.5 ), and stratified performance (Section 6.7 ), with a RAG-specific diagnostic in Section 6.6 . Bulky tables and method details are deferred to Appendices B , D , E and G .

blocks.en: 6.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 6.1 实验设置

blocks.en: We evaluate four categories of models in our benchmark experiments: • Extractive QA models based on IndoBERT variants, which predict answer spans directly from the given clinical context. • Generative QA models based on mT5, which generate free-form answers conditioned on the input question and contextual information. • Retrieval-Augmented QA (RAG) models, which first retrieve relevant clinical context from a pool of document chunks and then generate answers using a generative model, enabling reasoning over broader and potentially incomplete contexts. • Large Language Models (LLMs), evaluated in zero-shot and five-shot settings without task-specific fine-tuning, covering closed-source instruction-tuned models (GPT-4o-mini, GPT-4o), open-source multilingual models (Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct), Indonesian-tuned models (Sahabat-AI-Llama3-8B, Merak-7B-v4), and English-medical LLMs (BioMistral-7B, MedGemma-4B-IT) included to quantify cross-lingual transfer to Indonesian clinical text.
blocks.zh: 我们评价我们基准实验中的四类模型: • 基于IndoBERT变体的采掘QA模型,该模型从特定临床背景直接预测答案。 • 基于mT5的基因QA模型,生成以输入问题和背景信息为条件的自由式答案。 • 检索-增强QA(RAG)模型,这些模型首先从文件块集合中检索相关的临床背景,然后使用基因模型生成答案,从而能够对更广泛和可能不完整的背景进行推理。 大型语言模型(LLMS),在零发和五发的环境下评价,不进行特定任务的微调,包括闭源指令调制模型(GPT-4o-mini,GPT-4o),开源多语种模型(Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct,Quen2.5-7B-Instruct),印度尼西亚调制模型(Sahabat-AI-Llama3-8B,Merak-7B-v4),以及英语医学语言语言语言模型(BioMistral-7B, MedGemma-4B-IT),包括量化跨语向印度尼西亚临床文本的转移.

blocks.en: The dataset is split deterministically into 70 / 15 / 15 70/15/15 train/validation/test ( 637 637 / 137 137 / 137 137 pairs); pairs are ordered by source report so the train/test boundary has zero cross-report leakage, confirmed by the GroupKFold variant in Section 6.4 . The validation set is used exclusively for model selection during fine-tuning, while the test set is reserved for final evaluation. Fine-tuning is enabled for the extractive, generative, and RAG models using identical data splits to ensure a fair comparison. LLMs are evaluated on the same test split without any parameter updates, isolating their off-the-shelf clinical reasoning ability on Indonesian text.
blocks.zh: 数据集分解为70 / 15 / 15 70/15/15次列车/验证/测试(637 637 / 137 137 / 137 137对);对对对由来源报告订购,因此列车/测试边界有零跨报告泄漏,GroupKFold变体在第6.4节确认. 验证集在微调时专门用于模型选择,而测试集则保留用于最终评价. 对采掘模型、基因模型和RAG模型进行了精细调整,使用相同的数据分割,以确保公平比较。 LLMs在没有任何参数更新的情况下在同一测试分解上进行评估,将其现成的临床推理能力隔离在印尼文本上.

blocks.en: For extractive models, the maximum input sequence length is set to 512 tokens with a sliding window strategy to handle long clinical contexts. For the generative model, the input is formatted as a structured prompt consisting of the question followed by its clinical context. For LLMs, all models are queried with an identical Indonesian-language system prompt instructing the model to act as a clinical nutrition assistant and to answer strictly from the provided context. Decoding uses temperature 0 0 with a maximum of 256 256 new tokens. Few-shot exemplars are sampled deterministically from the training split with a fixed seed, ensuring that all LLMs see identical demonstration examples.
blocks.zh: 对于采掘模型,最大输入序列长度被设定为512个令牌,并带有滑动窗口策略,以处理长时间的临床环境. 对于基因模型,输入格式化为结构化的迅速,由问题及其临床背景组成。 对于LLMS来说,所有模型都使用一个相同的印度尼西亚语系统进行询问,即刻指示模型担任临床营养助理,并从所提供的背景中严格回答。 解码使用0温0,最高为256,256新令牌. 从训练中抽取的样本很少,但从训练中以固定种子分开,确保所有LLMs看到相同的演示实例。

blocks.en: Because the dataset contains 911 911 expert-curated QA pairs, the held-out test split alone ( n = 137 n=137 ) is small enough that a single point estimate could be misleading. We therefore complement the headline test-split numbers with three robustness procedures. First, the four fine-tuned models of Table 5 (Rifky_IndoBERT_QA, IndoLEM_IndoBERT, Cahya_IndoBERT, and mT5) are additionally evaluated under 5 5 -fold cross-validation stratified by source report, so that no chunk from a given clinical document appears in both training and evaluation folds; we report the per-fold mean and standard deviation alongside the headline test scores. Second, a learning-curve analysis re-trains the same four models on 10 % 10\% , 25 % 25\% , 50 % 50\% , and 100 % 100\% of the training split and evaluates each model on the same fixed test set; this quantifies how much additional expert annotation would be expected to improve performance. Third, we report bootstrap 95 % 95\% confidence intervals for every metric in every results table, computed with 1,000 1{,}000 resamples drawn with replacement from the test set. LLM zero-shot and few-shot evaluations are point estimates over the same test split (no parameter updates), but bootstrap confidence intervals over the same 1,000 1{,}000 resamples are reported alongside their scores so that all rows in our results tables are directly comparable in terms of statistical uncertainty.
blocks.zh: 由于数据集包含911 911 专家精准QA对,因此单独搁置的测试拆分(n = 137 n = 137)足够小,以至于一个单点估计可能具有误导性. 因此,我们用三个稳健性程序来补充头条的测试-分裂数字。 首先,对表5(Rifky_IndoBERT_QA,IndoLEM_IndoBERT,Cahya_IndoBERT,和mT5)的四个微调模型进行额外的评价,低于5-5倍的交叉验证,按源报告进行分级,因此特定临床文件的块不出现在训练和评价折叠中;我们报告与头条测试分数平行的每倍平均和标准偏差. 其次,一个学习曲线分析在10%的10\%、25%的25\%、50%的50\%和100%的100\%的训练中重新绘制了相同的四个模型,并在同一个固定测试集上对每个模型进行分拆和评估;这量化了预期会有多少额外的专家注释来提高绩效。 第三,我们报告每个结果表中每公尺95% 95 =%的置信间隔,用从测试中抽取的1,000 1{} = 1000个复标来计算。 LLM 0shot 和 少数shot 的评价是相同测试分数的点估计( 没有参数更新), 但同样 1 000 1{,} 5000 个复标值被报告在得分的同时, 以便我们的结果表中的所有行在统计不确定性方面直接可比 。

blocks.en: 6.2 Model Performance
blocks.zh: 6.2 模型性能

blocks.en: Table 2 reports all evaluated models on the test set, as percentages: extractive QA over IndoBERT variants, generative QA over mT5, and a retrieval-augmented (RAG) system.
blocks.zh: 表2按百分比汇报了测试组上的所有评价模型:印地语BERT变体的采掘质量评估、mT5的基因质量评估以及检索强化系统。

blocks.en: Table 2: All evaluated systems on the IndoNutriQA test split ( n = 137 n=137 ). The top block reports fine-tuned baselines (extractive, generative, retrieval-augmented); the rest report LLMs in zero- and five-shot settings under an identical Indonesian system prompt, temperature 0 0 , fixed few-shot sampling seed, and no parameter updates. Bold marks the best score per column.
blocks.zh: 表2:IndoNutriQA测试拆分上的所有评价系统(n=137n=137). 顶部区块报告微调基线(采掘、基因、检索-增强);其余区块报告LLMs在印度尼西亚相同的系统即时、0温度、固定的几发采样种子下以零和五发设置进行,没有参数更新。 粗体标出每列最佳分数.

blocks.en: The extractive baselines are span-prediction heads fine-tuned on our training split. Rifky_IndoBERT_QA ( Rifky/Indobert-QA ) is an IndoBERT-base checkpoint already fine-tuned for extractive QA on Indonesian SQuAD-style data before we fine-tune it further, which likely explains why it leads the extractive group: it starts from in-language QA supervision rather than a plain LM initialisation. Cahya_IndoBERT and IndoLEM_IndoBERT are general-purpose Indonesian BERT checkpoints without prior QA tuning; XLM-R-large and mDeBERTa-v3-base are multilingual encoders testing whether multilingual scale substitutes for Indonesian pretraining. The generative baseline is mt5-base , reused as the RAG generator. Among the extractive approaches, Rifky_IndoBERT_QA achieves the best overall performance (F1 = 36.34 =36.34 , EM = 12.41 =12.41 ). Because the references are free-form prose and only 8.7 % 8.7\% occur verbatim in the context, an extractive model cannot reproduce most of them: its EM and F1 are bounded by construction, and the EM–F1 gap reflects partial overlap with a passage rather than boundary errors on a single correct span. These scores measure locating reference-relevant text, not clinical correctness. Among the extractive models, the lower scores of IndoLEM_IndoBERT , Cahya_IndoBERT , and the multilingual encoders ( mDeBERTa-v3-base 19.35 19.35 , XLM-R-large 12.60 12.60 ) are consistent with in-language QA pretraining mattering more than multilingual scale.
blocks.zh: 采掘基线是跨度预测头 微调我们的训练分开。 Rifky_IndoBERTQQA(Rifky/Indobert-QA)是印度BERT基地的检查站,在我们进一步调整印尼SQuAD类数据之前,已经对QA采掘进行了微调,这很可能解释了它为什么领导采掘组:它起源于语言QA监督而不是简单的LM初始化. Cahya_IndoBERT和IndoLEM_IndoBERT是印度尼西亚通用的BERT检查站,没有之前的QA调试;XLM-R大调和mDeBERTa-v3基调是多语种编码器,测试印尼预训是否为多语种规模替代. 基因基线为mt5基,再利用为RAG生成器. 在采掘方法中,Rifky_ IndoBERTQQQA实现了最佳的整体性能(F1 = 36.34 = 36.34,EM = 12.41 = 12.41 ) 。 由于引用是自由形式传言,且只有8.7%的8.7QX在上下文中出现,因此采掘模型无法复制其中的大部分:其EM和F1以构造为界,EM-F1的缺口反映了在单个正确时段与通道而非边界错误的部分重叠. 这些分数衡量的是查找与参考相关的文本,而不是临床正确性. 在采掘模型中,IndoLEM_IndoBERT,Cahya_IndoBERT的较低分数,以及多语种编码器(mDeBERTa-v3-base 19.35 19.35,XLM-R-group 12.60 12.60)与语言QA预训比多语种规模更重要.

blocks.en: The mT5-based generative model performs substantially worse than extractive models, achieving an F1 score below 8% and an EM score of 0%. This result suggests that, for this model and data size, the fine-tuned generative baseline struggles to produce concise and clinically precise answers. Error analysis (the LLM-judged taxonomy of Section 6.7 and Table 17 in Appendix G ) shows that the model frequently generates generic or incomplete responses, which negatively affects both exact matching and lexical overlap metrics. The retrieval-augmented system yields near-zero lexical scores (ROUGE-1 and ROUGE-L below 3 % 3\% ; Table 2 ), which Section 6.6 localizes to the generator rather than the retriever.
blocks.zh: 基于mT5的基因模型的性能比采掘模型要差很多,达到F1分低于8%,EM分低于0%. 这一结果表明,对于这个模型和数据大小,细微调整的基因基线在生成简明和临床精确的答案方面挣扎. 错误分析(附录G第6.7节的LLM判断分类法和表17)显示,该模型经常产生通用或不完整的答复,这对精确匹配和词汇重叠的衡量标准都产生了负面影响。 检索增强系统得分接近零(ROUGE-1和ROUGE-L低于3%;表2),第6.6节将其定位到生成器,而不是检索器。

blocks.en: Among the fine-tuned systems we evaluated, the extractive models score highest on these overlap metrics, subject to the caveat above; Section 6.3 shows that five-shot LLMs nonetheless surpass all of them without any in-domain training.
blocks.zh: 在我们评价的微调系统中,采掘模型在这些重叠度量标准上得分最高,但需遵守上文的警告;第6.3节显示,5发LLMS虽然未经过任何内部培训,但仍超过所有LMS。

blocks.en: 6.3 Large Language Model Evaluation
blocks.zh: 6.3 大语文模式评价

blocks.en: We evaluate a suite of LLMs in zero- and five-shot settings on the same test split ( n = 137 n=137 ) as the fine-tuned baselines, spanning four families (closed-source, open-source multilingual, Indonesian-tuned, English-language medical). The LLM rows of Table 2 enable head-to-head comparison; this evaluation quantifies off-the-shelf clinical reasoning on Indonesian text and tests whether in-context demonstrations recover the gap to fine-tuned models. Figure 2 (Appendix G ) summarizes the three headline findings across its panels.
blocks.zh: 我们评价一组LLMs在零镜头和五镜头的设置下, 与微调基线相同(n=137n=137), 表2的LLM行可以进行头与头的比较;这一评价量化了印度尼西亚文本的现成临床推理,并测试内容内演示是否恢复到微调模型的空白. 图2(附录G)汇总了各小组的三个标题结论。

blocks.en: Three patterns emerge clearly from Table 2 . First, every evaluated LLM benefits substantially from five-shot prompting: gains range from + 7.0 +7.0 F1 (GPT-4o-mini) to + 17.7 +17.7 F1 (Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct), with Sahabat-AI-Llama3-8B a close second at + 16.5 +16.5 and frontier GPT-4o at + 12.8 +12.8 ( 37.49 → 50.33 37.49\rightarrow 50.33 ). The asymmetry is striking: smaller and language-tuned models benefit more than twice as much as the closed-source mini model, consistent with the hypothesis that few-shot exemplars primarily calibrate answer style (formal, terminology-rich, span-like) rather than imparting clinical knowledge, and that closed-source models already approximate the target style in zero-shot. Second, model scale matters less than prompt-formatting transfer: frontier GPT-4o (F1 = 50.33 =50.33 ) is matched by the smaller Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct ( 55.55 55.55 ) under five-shot prompting (overlapping CIs; Section 6.4 ), mirroring the same upset for GPT-4o-mini. Third, exact-match scores remain low across all LLMs even when token-overlap metrics are strong, confirming that LLMs produce paraphrased rather than verbatim spans: this is a metric artifact rather than a quality issue, and reinforces the case for semantic and clinician-judged evaluations discussed below.
blocks.zh: 表2明显地出现了三种模式。 首先,每个经评估的LLM都从五发催化得到很大好处:增益范围从+7.0+7.0 F1(GPT-4o-mini)到+17.7+17.7 F1(Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct),萨哈巴特-AI-Llama3-8B在+16.5+16.5时为接近秒数,前沿GPT-4o在+12.8+12.8时为秒数(37.49~50.33 37.49=12.8). 50.33) 不对称性惊人:较小且语言调性模型的好处比闭源迷你模型高出一倍以上,这符合以下假设:几发样本主要是校准解答风格(形式,名词丰富,跨度类似),而不是传授临床知识,闭源模型已经以零射法接近目标样式. 第二,模型尺度问题小于即时格式传输:前沿GPT-4o(F1 = 50.33 = 50.33)与较小的Llama-31-8B-Instruct(55.55.55)在五发提示(重叠CIS;第6.4节)下匹配,反射出同样对GPT-4o-mini的不安. 第三,所有法学硕士的准确对应分数仍然很低,即使象征性重叠的衡量标准很强,也证实法学硕士的成绩是被诠释的,而不是逐字记录的:这是一个衡量的文物,而不是一个质量问题,这加强了下文讨论的语义学和临床医生评价的理由。

blocks.en: A second comparison is between off-the-shelf LLMs and the best fine-tuned extractive baseline, Rifky_IndoBERT_QA (F1 = 36.34 =36.34 ). Even in zero-shot, GPT-4o-mini ( 36.06 36.06 ), GPT-4o ( 37.49 37.49 ), Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct ( 37.82 37.82 ), and MedGemma-4B-IT ( 42.60 42.60 ) match or exceed this baseline despite using no IndoNutriQA training data. With five-shot prompting the gap widens decisively: Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct reaches F1 = 55.55 =55.55 and MedGemma-4B-IT 54.28 54.28 , a statistical tie that also covers GPT-4o ( 50.33 50.33 ; see Section 6.4 ), + 19.21 +19.21 above the best fine-tuned model. At the data scale realistic for expert-annotated clinical resources in low-resource languages, IndoNutriQA’s primary value therefore lies in evaluation rather than supervised training: the strongest number on the benchmark is achieved by a model that saw only five in-context training exemplars and was never fine-tuned.
blocks.zh: 第二种比较是现成有限责任公司与最佳精细采掘基线Rifky_ IndoBERTQQQA(F1 = 36.34 = 36.34 ). 即使在零射中,GPT-4o-mini(36.06 36.06),GPT-4o(37.49 37.49),Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct(37.82 37.82),以及MedGemma-4B-IT(42.60 42.60)尽管没有使用IndoNutriQA的训练数据,但还是匹配或超过这一基线. 随着五发子弹的出现,差距明显扩大: Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct达到F1 = 55.55 = 55.55 和 MedGemma-4B-IT 54.28 54.28 统计平局也涵盖GPT-4o(50.33 50.33;见第6.4节),+ 19.21 + 19.21 最优微调模式以上. 因此,在以低资源语言提供专家说明的临床资源的数据尺度上,IndoNutriQA的主要价值在于评价,而不是监督培训:基准上最强的数字是通过一个只看到五个内在培训实例且从未微调的模式实现的。

blocks.en: In zero-shot, Indonesian-tuned models do not outperform multilingual peers (Sahabat-AI-Llama3-8B F1 = 26.78 =26.78 vs. Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 37.82 37.82 ; Merak-7B-v4 32.44 32.44 is on par with Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 31.03 31.03 ), whereas the smallest English-medical model, MedGemma-4B-IT at 4 4 B parameters, is the strongest zero-shot LLM overall (F1 = 42.60 =42.60 , ahead of both GPT-4o variants and Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct), with BioMistral-7B at 29.83 29.83 . With five-shot prompting MedGemma-4B-IT climbs to F1 = 54.28 =54.28 and the column-best BLEU ( 30.07 30.07 ), statistically tied with Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct ( 55.55 55.55 ) despite half the parameters. For these models the pattern is consistent with a domain-transfer account, in which medical English pretraining encodes clinical-reasoning structures (PES diagnoses, anthropometric thresholds) that general-domain Indonesian pretraining does not. The evidence is limited, however: it rests on two English-medical models, and BioMistral-7B ( 29.83 29.83 ) does not follow the pattern.
blocks.zh: 在0射法中,印尼调制的模型没有超过多语种同位素同位素(Sahabat-AI-Llama3-8B F1 = 26.78 = 26.78 = 26.78 对Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 37.82 37.82;Merak-7B-v4 32.44 32.44 32.44 与Quen2.5-7B-Instruct 31.03 31.03 等效),而最小的英医学模型MedGemma-4B-IT在4 B参数下是最强的零射法LM总体(F1 = 42.60 = 42.60,领先于GPT-4o变体和Llama-31-B-Instruct),与BioMistral-7B在29.83 29.83 29.83. 以五发催生MedGemma-4B-IT爬升至F1 = 54.28 = 54.28 和列最佳BLEU(30.07 30.07),统计上与Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct(55.55 55.55)绑定,尽管有一半参数. 对于这些模型来说,模式与域-转移账户一致,其中医学英语预训编码了临床-推理结构(PES诊断,人体测量阈值),印度尼西亚普通域的预训并不如此。 然而证据有限:它依赖于两个英医学模型,BioMistral-7B(29.83 29.83)没有遵循模式.

blocks.en: 6.4 Statistical Robustness Analysis
blocks.zh: 6.4 统计强度分析

blocks.en: To address the statistical-power concern from n = 137 n=137 we run 5 5 -fold cross-validation stratified by source report, a learning curve over training fractions, and bootstrap 95 % 95\% CIs on every metric. Rankings are stable: cross-validated F1 for the best extractive baseline ( 32.62 ± 1.29 32.62\pm 1.29 ) matches its held-out estimate ( 36.34 36.34 ), fold-level standard deviations stay ≤ 2.66 \leq 2.66 F1, and the top three 5 5 -shot LLMs cluster within overlapping intervals well above the best fine-tuned baseline. The learning curve separates data-bound from architecture-bound systems. Full tables are in Appendix B .
blocks.zh: 为了从n=137n=137解决统计能力问题,我们运行了5个5倍的交叉验证分级,由源报告进行分级,一个学习曲线凌驾于培训分数之上,以及每个度量标准上95%的95=CI。 排名是稳定的:最佳采掘基线(32.62 ± 1.29 32.62\pm 1.29)经过交叉验证的F1与其搁置估计值(36.34 36.34)相符,折叠水平标准差维持在2.66\leq 2.66 F1,重叠间隔远高于最佳微调基线的前三个5 5射LLMs集群。 学习曲线将数据捆绑与架构捆绑的系统分开. 完整的表格载于附录B。

blocks.en: 6.5 Beyond Lexical Overlap: Semantic and LLM-as-Judge Evaluation
blocks.zh: 6.5 超越表征重叠:语义论和LLM-as-Judge评价

blocks.en: Lexical-overlap metrics (EM, F1, BLEU, ROUGE) underestimate paraphrased LLM outputs. 2 2 2 Tokenisation and normalisation conventions differ across these metrics, and the SQuAD-derived normaliser has one Indonesian-specific side effect on exact match; see Appendix E . We add two semantic metrics (BERTScore F1 Zhang et al. (2020) with an XLM-R backbone Conneau et al. (2020) and multilingual sentence-embedding cosine) and one clinical-rubric signal (GPT-4o-mini LLM-as-judge on a 1 1 - 5 5 scale: factuality, completeness, safety), all with bootstrap 95 % 95\% CIs (Table 9 , Appendix E ). Two patterns stand out. (i) The LLM-vs-baseline gap widens on the semantic axes: top 5 5 -shot LLMs reach BERTScore F1 ≈ 91 \approx 91 and cosine ≈ 74 \approx 74 versus 46 46 / 45 45 for the best fine-tuned baseline, expanding the lexical-F1 + 19 +19 gap to ≈ + 45 \approx+45 . (ii) Closed-source models lead the clinical rubric (GPT-4o-mini overall 4.37 4.37 , GPT-4o safety 4.98 4.98 ) while Llama and MedGemma win the similarity axes; a second judge (Claude Haiku 4.5) preserves this ranking (pooled κ = 0.652 \kappa=0.652 , Spearman ρ = 0.916 \rho=0.916 ; Table 10 ), though the top rubric position itself is judge-dependent (GPT-4o leads under Claude). Because GPT-4o-mini is both judge and evaluated system, we test explicitly for self-preference and find no detectable effect (difference-in-differences + 0.125 +0.125 rubric points, p = 0.34 p=0.34 ; Appendix E ). Three expert raters independently re-scored a 50 50 -unit stratified sample: judge-vs-rater agreement approaches the inter-rater ceiling on factuality ( 0.705 0.705 vs 0.780 0.780 ) and completeness ( 0.623 0.623 vs 0.752 0.752 ) but collapses on clinical safety ( 0.133 0.133 ), where both judges score well above the rater consensus (Appendix E ). We therefore treat the safety column as unvalidated.

blocks.en: 6.8 Human Error Analysis

blocks.en: The taxonomy above is assigned by an LLM judge, which makes it circular as evidence about that judge and blind to what the judge cannot see. We therefore built an independent human counterpart: during the calibration study the three raters could leave a free-text note on any unit with no taxonomy shown to them, and 53 53 notes were written over 37 37 of the 50 50 units. Error identification is thus human and unprompted; we coded the notes into nine categories (Table 14 and Appendix F , which also records the method and its caveats, chiefly that notes were optional, so every count is a lower bound).
blocks.zh: 上面的分类学是由一位LLM法官指派的,这使得它成为该法官的循环证据,对法官所看不到的东西视而不见. 因此,我们建立了一个独立的人类对应单位:在校准研究期间,三个评分者可以在任何没有向他们展示分类的单位上留下自由文字注释,50个单位中,有37个单位写了53个53个注释。 因此,错误识别是人性的,没有发生;我们把笔记编码为9个类别(表14和附录F,它们也记录方法及其说明,主要是笔记是可选的,所以每个计数都是下限).

blocks.en: Two findings do not follow from the LLM-judged taxonomy. First, the raters name a failure class the judge’s codebook does not contain: violation of the NCP/PES structure ( 6 6 units, 12 % 12\% ), most often expanding the “S” of PES as Solusi (solution) rather than Sign/Symptom, or collapsing several diagnoses into one undifferentiated statement. Every instance falls on the nutrition-diagnosis question, and no lexical, semantic, or judge metric here detects it.

blocks.en: Second, the raters flagged unsupported added content in 5 5 units ( 10 % 10\% ) that the judge’s hallucination label did not flag. Three concern figures that cannot be checked against the reference, the weaker reading; the remaining two are substantive: the candidate asserts a weight-loss trend for a patient whose record contains no weight history, and one of the two was flagged independently by two raters. GPT-4o-mini scored those units 4 4 on factuality and 5 5 on safety. We therefore make no claim about the absence of hallucination, and the judge’s hallucination label should not be used as a safety indicator: a reference-only comparison cannot see a claim the patient record silently fails to license.

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en: IndoNutriQA fills a gap in Indonesian-language clinical QA with 911 911 pairs written by three nutritionists and grounded in real clinical-nutrition reports written by graduate-level dietetic interns. The strongest results form a statistically tied top tier of 5 5 -shot LLMs (Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct F1 = 55.55 =55.55 , MedGemma-4B-IT 54.28 54.28 ), above the best fine-tuned IndoBERT baseline by + 19.21 +19.21 F1, supporting IndoNutriQA as an evaluation resource. These conclusions are limited to the eight question types, the clinical reports, and the configurations tested. An expert-rater audit found 6 6 – 10 % 10\% of references contestable, safety scores unvalidated, and unsupported content the judge missed, so we claim no hallucination-free output. Future work will add cases from other facilities, extend the expert audit, and test stronger Indonesian generators for RAG.

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en: This work has several limitations that should be considered when interpreting the results and using the IndoNutriQA dataset.
blocks.zh: 这项工作有一些局限性,在解释结果和使用IndoNutriQA数据集时应当考虑这些局限性.

blocks.en: First, the size of the dataset is modest at 911 911 question-answer pairs from 120 120 source reports. This reflects the realistic constraints of collecting and annotating clinical data with clinical nutrition experts, and we therefore frame IndoNutriQA primarily as an evaluation benchmark rather than a large-scale training corpus (Sections 6.3 – 6.4 ). To address the statistical-power concern that follows from this scale, we report 5 5 -fold cross-validation stratified by source report (with GroupKFold forbidding any cross-report contamination), a learning-curve analysis over training-set fractions, and bootstrap 95 % 95\% confidence intervals on every headline metric, in addition to zero-shot and five-shot LLM evaluations that require no in-domain training data. Nevertheless, the modest scale limits the benchmark’s ability to expose tail behaviours of data-hungry generative and retrieval-augmented systems; reported numbers should be interpreted as benchmark references rather than upper-bound performance estimates achievable with substantially more data.
blocks.zh: 首先,数据集的大小在911 911问题回答对120份120份来源报告时是适度的. 这反映了与临床营养专家收集和注释临床数据的现实限制,因此,我们把IndoNutriQA主要作为评价基准,而不是大规模培训(第6.3–6.4节)。 为解决从这一尺度得出的统计能力关切,我们报告有5个5倍的交叉验证分级,由来源报告(GroupKFold禁止任何交叉报告污染),对培训部分进行学习曲线分析,每个头条标尺上95%的95===置信间隔,此外还有零射和五射的LLM评价,不需要内部培训数据。 然而,适度的比额表限制了基准暴露数据饥饿基因和检索强化系统的尾端行为的能力;报告的数字应被解释为基准参考,而不是用大量数据可以实现的上限业绩估计。

blocks.en: A related concern is the scope of the question set. IndoNutriQA is built from eight fixed questions rather than free-form ones, which bounds what the benchmark can measure: it exercises the eight NCP/PES reasoning steps that structure Indonesian clinical-nutrition practice, and nothing outside them. It therefore does not test open-ended clinical dialogue, patient-initiated questions, or reasoning about sections of the report the eight questions do not touch (for instance pharmacological interactions or longitudinal monitoring, both present in the source documents but unqueried). We regard the fixed question set as a deliberate trade of coverage for control, since it makes answers comparable across 120 120 patients and bounds inter-annotator variation, but it is a real ceiling on scope, and extending the question inventory is the most direct way to raise it.
blocks.zh: 一个相关的关切是问题集的范围。 IndoNutriQA是由8个固定问题而不是自由形式问题构建的,它约束了基准可以衡量的内容:它行使了8个NCP/PES推理步骤来构建印尼的临床营养实践,除了这些步骤之外,没有别的. 因此,它不测试不限成员名额的临床对话、病人提出的问题,也不测试关于报告各节的推理,8个问题没有触及(例如药理学相互作用或纵向监测,两者都载于来源文件,但没有说明)。 我们认为,固定问题集是故意的涵盖范围交易,因为它使120名病人的答案具有可比性,并且是通知人之间的差异,但它是范围的真正上限,扩大问题清单是提出这一问题的最直接方式。

blocks.en: A further concern is the number of source documents rather than the number of pairs: 911 911 pairs drawn from 120 120 reports average roughly 7.5 7.5 pairs per report, so case diversity is bounded by the report count regardless of how many pairs are extracted. Three considerations bear on this. First, the eight questions are standardised and applied uniformly to every report, so the pairs within a report are not near-duplicates of one another but probe eight distinct sections of the NCP; the effective diversity of the benchmark is therefore closer to 120 120 cases × \times 8 8 reasoning types than to 911 911 interchangeable items. Second, because the question side is fixed, annotator variation is confined to answer text, which is what makes a corpus of this size usable as a controlled evaluation instrument rather than merely a small training set. Third, the 120 120 reports are not drawn from a single site or a single condition: they span multiple healthcare facilities and ten disease categories with no category exceeding 30 % 30\% of reports (Table 18 ). None of this removes the ceiling that 120 120 documents impose on rare-case coverage, which we return to below; it does mean the constraint is on case breadth rather than on redundancy among the pairs.
blocks.zh: 另一个令人关切的问题是来源文件的数量,而不是对数:从120份120份报告中抽取的911 911对每份报告平均约7.5对,因此,无论抽取了多少对,报告都以数字为范围。 有三个因素涉及这一点。 首先,这八个问题已标准化,并统一适用于每份报告,因此,报告内的对子并非彼此几乎重复,而是探究国家CP的八个不同部分;因此,基准的有效多样性接近120 120个案例xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx 第二,由于提问方是固定的,注释员的变异仅限于回答文本,因此这种大小的集合可以用作受控评价工具,而不仅仅是一个小的训练集. 第三,120份报告不是从一个单一地点或一个单一条件提取的:它们涉及多个保健设施和10个疾病类别,没有超过30%的30-%的报告(表18)。 所有这些都没有取消120份120份文件对罕见案件覆盖所施加的上限,我们回到下文;这确实意味着限制在于案件宽度,而不是对两个文件的冗余。

blocks.en: Second, the dataset exhibits domain and population skew. A substantial portion of the cases is derived from pediatric and respiratory-related clinical contexts, reflecting real-world hospital data availability, although no single disease category exceeds 30 % 30\% of source reports (Table 18 ). We explicitly stratify performance by disease category in Section 6.7 (Table 16 ) and find that the dataset-level respiratory prominence does not translate to biased generalisation: Llama-3.1-8B (5-shot) ranges 50.08 50.08 – 64.17 64.17 F1 across the seven categories represented in the test split, with respiratory ( 57.55 57.55 ) sitting within the spread. Two caveats remain. First, the held-out test split is not stratified by disease category: it over-represents neurologic ( 20.0 % 20.0\% vs. 10.0 % 10.0\% of the corpus) and hematologic/oncologic ( 15.0 % 15.0\% vs. 8.3 % 8.3\% ) while under-representing infectious ( 5.0 % 5.0\% vs. 17.5 % 17.5\% ), and contains no cardiac or renal/urologic reports at all, so generalisation to those conditions remains untested on the held-out split. Second, the 5 5 -fold cross-validation of Section 6.4 uses GroupKFold over all 120 120 reports and therefore does exercise every category, which is the stronger evidence for category-level robustness.
blocks.zh: 第二,数据集显示域和人口skew。 大部分病例来自儿科和呼吸道相关临床背景,反映了真实世界的医院数据,尽管没有单一疾病类别超过30%(表18)。 在第6.7节(表16)中,我们按疾病类别明确划分性能,并发现数据集一级呼吸道的突出程度并没有导致偏颇的概括: Llama-31-8B(5发子弹)射程50.08 50.08 – 64.17 64.17 F1在试验分拆中代表的7个类别中,呼吸道(57.55 57.55)位于传播范围. 仍有两项告诫。 首先,被搁置的测试分裂没有按疾病类别进行分级:它过度表现神经病(20.0% = 20.0 = 10.0 = 10.0 = 10.0 = 10.0 )和血液/肿瘤(15.0% 15.0 = 8.3 = 8.3 = 8.3 = 7.5 = 17.5 = 17.5 = 17.5 = 17.5 = ),而且根本没有心脏或肾脏/泌尿科报告,因此,对这些状况的概论在搁置分裂中仍然没有经过测试。 其次,第6.4节的5个5倍的交叉验证在所有120个报告中使用了GroupKFold,因此,确实行使了每个类别,这是类别一级坚固性的更有力证据。

blocks.en: This bears directly on how far the reported results should be expected to generalise. Across institutions: the reports are authored at multiple Indonesian healthcare facilities spanning public regional hospitals, private medical centres, and a military hospital, rather than at a single site. This matters because clinical-nutrition documentation is shaped by institutional templates, and a benchmark drawn from one hospital would reward models that learn that hospital’s report layout. Two design choices limit that risk: the eight standardised questions derive from the NCP and PES frameworks, which are national practice standards rather than site conventions, and the cross-validation groups by source report so that no institutional template appears in both training and evaluation folds, with fold-level standard deviations remaining small ( ≤ 2.66 \leq 2.66 F1). What remains untested is transfer to facilities outside the contributing set, particularly primary-care puskesmas settings, where documentation is briefer and less standardised than the inpatient reports collected here. Across rare conditions: renal/urologic and ENT cases each account for under 1 % 1\% of source reports, and for conditions represented by one or two reports no partition can support a reliable per-category estimate. We would expect degradation on conditions whose nutritional management diverges sharply from the modal pediatric case, for instance renal diets with protein and electrolyte restriction, which invert the high-protein prescriptions dominating this corpus. Extending coverage of these conditions is the highest-value direction for a second data-collection round, and we flag it explicitly so that users of the benchmark do not over-read aggregate scores as evidence of broad clinical competence.
blocks.zh: 这直接关系到所报告结果的普及程度。 各个机构:报告是在印度尼西亚的多个保健设施撰写的,这些保健设施跨越公立地区医院、私人医疗中心和一所军事医院,而不是在一个地点。 这很重要,因为临床营养文件是由机构模板决定的,从一家医院提取的基准将奖励了解医院报告布局的模型。 两个设计选择限制了这一风险:八个标准化问题来自国家CP和PES框架,后者是国家惯例标准,而不是地点公约,以及按来源报告划分的交叉验证组,这样在培训和评价折叠中都不出现机构模板,折叠水平标准差仍然很小(\ 2.66\leq 2.66 F1)。 尚未测试的是转移到缴款套件以外的设施,特别是初级保健的puskesmas环境,那里的文件比这里收集的住院报告更简洁,更不规范。 在罕见的条件下:肾脏/泌尿病和ENT病例各占来源报告的1%以下,对于一两个报告所代表的条件,任何分区都无法支持可靠的每类估计数。 我们预计营养管理与模式儿科病例有巨大差异的病情会恶化,例如,肾上腺饮食中含有蛋白质和电解质限制,这颠倒了支配此病原体的高蛋白处方。 扩大这些条件的覆盖范围是第二轮数据收集工作的最高价值方向,我们明确标出这一点,使基准用户不会过度阅读汇总分数,作为临床能力广泛的证据。

blocks.en: Third, single-annotator pairs do not guarantee a unique gold answer per question, particularly for the recommendation-style questions. We mitigate this on two axes: the NCP/PES guideline structurally constrains acceptable answers (Appendix A.1 ), and our evaluation protocol uses paraphrase-tolerant semantic and rubric metrics (Section 6.5 ) alongside lexical scores. We also report inter-rater agreement directly: three expert raters independently re-scored 50 50 stratified test-split units (Appendix E ), reaching quadratic-weighted κ = 0.780 \kappa=0.780 on factuality and 0.752 0.752 on completeness but only 0.160 0.160 on clinical safety. The same exercise flagged 3 3 of 50 50 reference answers ( 6 % 6\% ) as incorrect or contestable by explicit flag, rising to 5 5 ( 10 % 10\% ) if free-text criticism of the reference is counted (Section 4 ); we take this as a direct estimate of gold-answer error in the test split, and those items are released with the benchmark so they can be excluded or re-adjudicated. Because two of the three raters also wrote references, this estimate is not fully independent. Extending this re-annotation beyond 50 50 units, and to the training split, remains future work.
blocks.zh: 第三,单标注人配对并不能保证每个问题都有独特的黄金答案,特别是推荐式的问题. 我们从两个方面减轻这种情况:国家CP/PES准则在结构上限制了可接受的答案(附录A.1),我们的评估协议使用语义容忍语义和语义衡量标准(第6.5节)与词汇分数。 我们还直接报告判决间协议:3名专家评分员独立重新评分50个50个分级试卷单元(附录E),在事实质量上达到四重制=0.780\kappa=0.780,在完整性上达到0.7520.752,但在临床安全上仅达到0.1600.160。 50个参考答案中的3个(6% 6 QQ)被明确标注为不正确或可争辩, 如果计算出对参考内容的自由文本批评, 则上升至5 5(10% 10 QQ) (第 4 节) ; 我们将此作为测试拆分中金答错的直接估计, 且这些内容会随基准释放, 以便排除或重新判断。 由于三个评分中有两个也写了参考文献,这个估计并不完全独立. 今后的工作仍然是将这种重新说明扩大到50个单元之外,以及将培训分开。

blocks.en: Fourth, all data are sourced from Indonesian healthcare facilities and written in Indonesian. While this is a deliberate design choice to support low-resource clinical NLP, it restricts direct applicability to other languages and healthcare systems without additional adaptation. The benchmark does provide partial cross-lingual signals, since two large multilingual encoders (XLM-R-large, mDeBERTa-v3-base) are fine-tuned on the Indonesian training data, and two English medical LLMs (BioMistral-7B, MedGemma-4B-IT) are evaluated zero- and five-shot on Indonesian clinical text, but a parallel English-translated test split for fully aligned cross-lingual experiments is left for future work.
blocks.zh: 第四,所有数据都来自印度尼西亚保健设施,并以印度尼西亚语写成。 虽然这是支持低资源临床NLP的刻意设计选择,但它限制了直接适用于其他语言和卫生保健系统而不作进一步调整. 该基准确实提供了部分跨语言信号,因为两个大型多语言编码器(XLM-R-大,mDeBERTa-v3-base)在印尼培训数据上进行了微调,两个英语医学LLMs(BioMistral-7B,MedGemma-4B-IT)在印尼临床文本上进行了零射和五射的评价,但一个平行的英语翻译测试分解,用于完全对齐的跨语言实验,留待未来工作.

blocks.en: Fifth, although the evaluation protocol goes beyond lexical-overlap metrics (Section 6.5 adds BERTScore, sentence-embedding cosine, and an LLM-as-judge clinical rubric, with a second-judge cross-validation using Claude Haiku 4.5 yielding pooled κ = 0.652 \kappa=0.652 ), per-prediction human evaluation by expert raters was conducted on a 50 50 -unit stratified sample rather than at full scale (Appendix E ). That calibration validates the rubric unevenly. On factuality and completeness, judge-vs-rater agreement ( κ = 0.705 \kappa=0.705 and 0.623 0.623 for GPT-4o-mini) approaches the inter-rater ceiling ( 0.780 0.780 and 0.752 0.752 ), so on those dimensions the judge is about as close to a rater as raters are to each other. On clinical safety it does not: agreement is κ = 0.133 \kappa=0.133 (GPT-4o-mini) and 0.480 0.480 (Claude Haiku 4.5), and both judges score safety above the rater consensus, by + 1.14 +1.14 and + 0.58 +0.58 rubric points respectively. The raters also disagree among themselves on safety (Krippendorff α = 0.250 \alpha=0.250 ), so this is not solely a judge failure: safety as operationalised here lacks a stable human target. We therefore report the safety column as unvalidated, and no safety score in this paper should be read as a clinical guarantee. At 50 50 units the per-stratum intervals remain wide, and agreement on a stratified sample need not transfer to the full test split. The human error analysis derived from the same exercise (Section 6.8 ) carries its own limits: the raters’ notes were optional and unevenly distributed across the three raters, so its category counts are lower bounds on prevalence rather than error rates, and the coding of those notes into categories is ours rather than the raters’ (Appendix F ). It is nonetheless the finding that most changes how our own results should be read, since it shows the judge’s hallucination label to be a detection ceiling rather than a measure of unsupported clinical content. The primary judge (GPT-4o-mini) also provides two evaluated systems; a difference-in-differences test against a control judge from a different provider finds no detectable self-preference (Appendix E ), but with four same-provider systems that test is underpowered, and it cannot rule out a stylistic prior shared by both judges.
blocks.zh: 第五,虽然评价协议超越了词汇重叠度量表(第6.5节增加了BERTScore, 句子嵌入式Cosiine, 以及一个LLM即位法官临床标语,第二名法官使用Claude Haiku 4.5 生成 ob = 0.652\kappa= 0.652 ),但专家评分员的人均人评价是在50个单元分级抽样上进行的,而不是在全比例上进行的(附录E)。 这种校准验证了标点不均匀。 关于事实和完整性,法官-法官协定(GPT-4o-mini=0.705\kappa=0.705和0.6230.623)接近法官间上限(0.780 0.780和0.752 0.752),因此,法官在这些维度上与法官之间接近。 在临床安全方面,没有:协议=0.133\kappa=0.133(GPT-4o-mini)和0.480 0.480(Claude Haiku 4.5),两位评委分别以+1.14+1.14和+0.58+0.58卢布的分数获得安全性高于评分共识。 评测者在安全性方面也存在分歧(Krippendorff α = 0.250\alpha = 0.250),因此这不仅仅是法官的失误:这里操作的安全性缺乏稳定的人类目标. 因此,我们报告安全栏目未经核实,本文中的任何安全分数都不应被理解为临床保证. 50个单元的每层间隔仍然很宽,关于分层抽样的协议不需要转移到完全试验分裂。 从同一行为(第6.8节)得出的人为错误分析有其自身的限度:评分者笔记是可选的,在三种评分者之间分布不均,因此其类别计数对流行率的界限较低,而不是差错率,将这些笔记编码成类别是我们的,而不是评分者(附录F)。 法官的幻觉标签是检测天花板, 主裁判(GPT-4o-mini)也提供两个被评价的系统;针对来自不同提供者的控制裁判的差分测试发现没有可探测的自我偏好(Appendix E),但有四个相同的提供裁判系统测试能力不足,不能排除两个裁判事先共享的风格.

blocks.en: Finally, the retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) baseline exhibits low lexical scores. The RAGAS diagnostic in Section 6.6 localises this to the mt5-base generator (faithfulness 12.86 12.86 on the 105 105 of 137 137 examples where it is defined, answer relevancy 0.24 0.24 ) while the retriever is the stronger component (context precision 73.43 73.43 ). Because we evaluate a single retriever–generator–chunking configuration, these numbers should be read as a localisation of failure within that configuration and not as evidence about the effectiveness of RAG for Indonesian clinical QA in general. A stronger Indonesian generator with grounding-aware training is the most direct next step, and retriever-side changes (recall is only 35.98 35.98 ) were not tested; both are left for future work.
blocks.zh: 最后,检索增强的生成(RAG)基线显示出低词汇分数。 第6.6节中RAGAS的诊断将它定位到mt5基生成器(在137个实例中,有105个实例,回答相关性,0.24 0.24),而检索器是更强大的组件(文字精度73.43 73.43)。 由于我们评价一个单一的检索器-生成器-充电配置,这些数字应该被解读为该配置中故障的本地化,而不是证明RAG对一般印度尼西亚临床QA的有效性。 具有地面意识训练的更强大的印度尼西亚发电机是最直接的下一步,回收机侧变化(只召回35.98 35.98)没有经过测试;两者都留给未来工作。

blocks.en: Despite these limitations, IndoNutriQA provides a clinically grounded and ethically curated resource that establishes a foundation for future research in Indonesian clinical question answering and nutrition-focused decision support.
blocks.zh: 尽管存在这些局限性,IndoNutriQA还是提供了基于临床的、符合道德要求的资源,为今后印度尼西亚临床问题回答和以营养为重点的决策支持的研究奠定了基础。

blocks.en: Ethics Statement
blocks.zh: 道德操守说明

blocks.en: This work involves the construction and release of a clinical question answering dataset derived from real-world clinical nutrition reports. Ethical considerations related to data privacy, consent, potential harm, and responsible use were carefully addressed throughout the dataset development and release process.
blocks.zh: 这项工作涉及构建并发布从现实世界临床营养报告中得出的临床问题解答数据集. 在整个数据集开发和发布过程中,认真处理了与数据隐私、同意、潜在危害和负责任的使用有关的道德考虑。

blocks.en: Patient-level anonymisation. All source documents were fully anonymised prior to annotation and release. Personally identifiable information (PII), including patient names, medical record numbers, registration numbers, addresses, and dates of birth, was removed using rule-based procedures tailored to Indonesian clinical documents and replaced with deterministic placeholders ( <NAMA> , <NO_RM> , <NO_REG> , <TGL> , <LOKASI> ). As a result, the released dataset does not contain information that can be used to identify individual patients. No attempts were made to re-identify individuals, and the dataset is intended solely for research and educational purposes.
blocks.zh: 患者一级匿名. 所有来源文件在说明和发布前都完全匿名。 个人可识别信息(PII),包括病人姓名、医疗记录号码、登记号码、地址和出生日期,均根据印度尼西亚临床文件的规定程序删除,代之以确定占位符( " NAMA " 、 " NO_RM " 、 " NO_REG " 、 " TGL " 、 " LOKASI " )。 因此,所发布的数据集并不包含可用于识别个体患者的信息. 没有试图重新识别个人,数据集仅用于研究和教育目的。

blocks.en: Institution-level anonymisation. A second anonymisation pass strips identifying institution mentions that the per-chunk NER list would not catch but that nevertheless identify the host site: hospital names ( <RS> , e.g., regional public hospitals, private medical centers, military naval hospitals, and other named or acronym hospital references) and publisher names attached to academic citations ( <PENERBIT> , e.g., medical textbook publishers, university presses). The two passes together leave the released dataset stripped of both individual-patient and host-institution identifiers.
blocks.zh: 机构一级匿名。 第二项匿名条状识别机构提到,每吨NER列表不会收到,但会注明主办地点:医院名称( " RS " ,例如区域公立医院、私人医疗中心、海军医院和其他名称或缩略语的医院参考文献)和学术引文所附的出版商名称( " PENERBIT " ,例如医学教科书出版商、大学出版社)。 这两段路经合在一起,使所公布的数据集失去个人-病人和东道机构识别资料。

blocks.en: Annotation and consent. The dataset was constructed from retrospective clinical-nutrition reports authored by graduate-level dietetic interns as part of supervised clinical nutrition rotations. No direct patient contact or intervention was involved in this study. Each (report, question, answer) triple has exactly one author, one of three nutritionists who wrote the answers to reports that graduate-level dietetic interns had written under lecturer supervision (Appendix A ). The study does not include vulnerable-population targeting beyond what is inherent in clinical nutrition practice (e.g., pediatric cases), and no demographic attributes were collected or inferred beyond those explicitly documented in anonymised clinical contexts.
blocks.zh: 注释与同意. 数据集是根据研究生一级营养问题实习生作为受监督的临床营养轮换的一部分编写的追溯性临床营养报告构建的。 这项研究没有涉及病人的直接接触或干预。 每个(报告,问题,回答)三部曲都有一位作者,是三位营养学家之一,他们撰写了研究生级饮食实习生在讲师监督下撰写的报告(附录A)的答案. 这项研究不包括超出临床营养实践内在的脆弱人口目标(如儿科病例),除了匿名临床环境中明确记载的人口属性外,没有收集或推断人口属性。

blocks.en: Intended use. IndoNutriQA is released with the explicit intention of supporting research in clinical natural language processing and low-resource language question answering. The dataset is not intended for direct clinical deployment or automated medical decision making. Any predictions or recommendations generated by models trained or evaluated on this dataset should be interpreted as decision-support signals and must not replace professional medical judgement.
blocks.zh: 拟用. IndoNutriQA的发布明确旨在支持临床自然语言处理的研究和低资源语言问题回答. 该数据集并非用于直接临床部署或医疗自动决策。 由在本数据集上培训或评价的模型产生的任何预测或建议,应解释为决策支持信号,不得取代专业医学判断。

blocks.en: Risks and mitigations. Potential risks include the misuse of trained models for unsupported clinical inference or deployment without appropriate validation. To mitigate this: (i) the dataset documentation states usage limitations explicitly; (ii) benchmark results are reported as baseline references with bootstrap confidence intervals rather than performance guarantees (Section 6.4 ); (iii) we make no claim that the evaluated systems are free of hallucination: the LLM judge’s hallucination label is unvalidated, and expert raters auditing the same kind of output independently identified unsupported clinical additions in 10 % 10\% of units, two of them asserting findings the patient record does not license (Section 6.8 ); and (iv) the LLM-as-judge clinical rubric is cross-validated across two judge families (GPT-4o-mini and Claude Haiku 4.5, pooled Cohen’s κ = 0.652 \kappa=0.652 ; Section 6.5 ). Researchers using IndoNutriQA are nevertheless encouraged to conduct additional validation, including expert review by qualified clinicians, before applying derived models in real-world clinical settings.
blocks.zh: 风险和缓解。 潜在风险包括滥用训练有素的模型进行无根据的临床推断或部署,而没有适当的验证。 为了减轻这种情况:(一) 数据集文件明确说明了使用限制;(二) 基准结果被报告为基准参考文献,并带有靴子置信间隔,而不是性能保障(第6.4节);(三) 我们没有声称被评价的系统没有幻觉:LLM法官的幻觉标签没有认证,对同一种产出进行审核的专家在10%的单位中独立识别出无根据的临床添加物,其中两名专家断言病人记录不合格的调查结果(第6.8节);(四) LLM-as法官的临床价值跨两个法官家庭(GPT-4o-mini和Claud Ha 4.5,集合Cohen's =0.652\kappa=0.652;第6.5节)。 使用 IndoNutri 的研究人员 不过,鼓励质量评估在现实世界临床环境中应用衍生模型之前进行更多的验证,包括由合格的临床医生进行专家审查。

blocks.en: Overall, this work adheres to established ethical guidelines for clinical NLP research, prioritising patient privacy, institutional anonymity, transparency, and responsible use while contributing a valuable resource for advancing medical and nutritional decision support in low-resource language contexts.
blocks.zh: 总体而言,这项工作符合临床NLP研究的既定道德准则,优先考虑病人的隐私、机构匿名性、透明度和负责任的使用,同时为在低资源语言背景下推进医疗和营养决策支持提供了宝贵的资源。

The dataset is released under CC BY-NC 4.0, and the code is released under the MIT license.

blocks.en: A.1 Question Types and Complexity
blocks.zh: A.1 问题类型和复杂性

blocks.en: The questions in IndoNutriQA are designed to reflect real-world clinical nutrition workflows and span multiple levels of reasoning complexity. Overall, the dataset includes four major categories of questions. Factual questions target explicit clinical information such as anthropometric measurements, laboratory values, or diagnostic outcomes. Inferential questions require clinical reasoning by integrating multiple pieces of contextual information, for example combining anthropometric findings with medical diagnoses. Comparative questions involve assessing differences across parameters or time points, such as changes in nutritional status or laboratory indicators. Finally, recommendation questions focus on clinical decision support, asking for appropriate dietary goals, principles, or guidelines based on the patient’s condition.
blocks.zh: IndoNutriQA中的问题旨在反映现实世界的临床营养工作流程,并跨越多个层次的推理复杂性. 总的来说,数据集包括四大类问题。 事实问题针对明确的临床信息,如人体测量测量,实验室值,或诊断结果. 推论问题需要临床推理,通过整合多个背景信息,例如将人体测量结果与医学诊断相结合. 比较问题涉及评估不同参数或时间点之间的差异,如营养状况或实验室指标的变化。 最后,建议问题侧重于临床决策支持,要求根据病人的状况制定适当的饮食目标、原则或准则。

blocks.en: To ensure consistency and comprehensive coverage across cases, each patient record is associated with a standardized set of NCP/PES questions that operationalize these categories. The complete list of standardized questions applied uniformly to all cases is provided in Appendix I . These questions collectively cover factual assessment, clinical reasoning, and recommendation-oriented decision making, ensuring that models trained on IndoNutriQA are evaluated across a broad spectrum of clinically relevant clinical question answering scenarios. Table 3 gives the main dataset statistics, including the average question, answer, and context lengths.
blocks.zh: 为确保病例的一致性和全面覆盖,每一份病历都与一套标准化的国家CP/PES问题有关,使这些类别得以运作。 附录一载有统一适用于所有案件的标准化问题的完整清单。 这些问题共同涵盖事实评估,临床推理,以及以建议为导向的决策,确保接受过关于IndoNutriQA培训的模型在广泛的临床相关临床问题解答情景中得到评价. 表3列出了主要数据集统计数据,包括平均问题、答案和上下文长度。
