blocks.en: Annotator Pool
blocks.zh: 注释库

blocks.en: The 120 120 source reports were written by graduate-level dietetic interns at the Faculty of Health Sciences, Universitas Brawijaya, as inpatient or sub-inpatient clinical rotation deliverables of a dietetic internship. Each report was supervised by a lecturer of the faculty. The reports are the source material, not the annotation. The question answers were written by three nutritionists, each assigned a different set of reports. Each nutritionist wrote the eight answers for every report in their set.
blocks.zh: 120份资料来源报告是由布拉维贾亚大学健康科学系的研究生一级饮食实习人员撰写的,作为饮食实习的住院或副住院临床轮换交付品。 每份报告都由一名系讲师监督。 报告是来源材料,而不是注释。 问答由三位营养学家撰写,每人分配了一套不同的报告. 每个营养学家都为每一份报告写了八个答案。

blocks.en: Per-pair Annotation Count and Validation
blocks.zh: 每页注释数和验证

blocks.en: Each (report, question) pair is answered by exactly one nutritionist. We do not collect multiple independent annotations of the same pair, because adding parallel annotators would duplicate the entire chart-review workflow per report and was outside the scope of this dataset release. A stratified sample of 50 50 units of model output was later re-scored by one Registered Dietitian, who took no part in writing the answers, and two of the three nutritionists (Appendix E ). That study provides the only validation of the reference answers; we do not claim that all pairs were reviewed.
blocks.zh: 每对(报告,问题)都由一个营养学家回答。 我们不收集同一对的多个独立注释,因为添加平行的注释符会重复每份报告的整个图表审查工作流程,并且不属于本数据集发布的范围. 50个模型输出单元的分级样本后来被一位注册的迪蒂蒂安重新评分,他没有参与写出答案,还有三位营养学家中的两位(附录E). 该研究提供了参考答案的唯一验证;我们并不声称所有对子都经过审查。

blocks.en: Annotation Guideline
blocks.zh: 注释准则

blocks.en: The nutritionists followed the clinical-nutrition documentation guideline used in the clinical nutrition rotations, which is grounded in two standardized clinical-nutrition reference frameworks: the Nutrition Care Process (NCP) for clinical-nutrition documentation, and the PES (Problem–Etiology–Sign/Symptom) format for nutrition diagnosis statements. The eight standardized questions correspond directly to NCP/PES sections (screening, anthropometric assessment, biochemical assessment, nutrition diagnosis, dietary goals, dietary principles, dietary requirements, dietary guidelines), so the answer space for each question is bounded by the NCP/PES rubric rather than by free-form clinical opinion.
blocks.zh: 营养学家遵循临床营养轮换中使用的临床营养文献准则,该准则以两个标准化的临床营养参考框架为基础:临床营养文献的营养护理进程(NCP)和营养诊断说明的PES(问题-Etiology-Sign/Symptom)格式。 八个标准化问题直接对应NCP/PES部分(筛选,人体测量评估,生化评估,营养诊断,饮食目标,饮食原则,饮食要求,饮食准则),因此每个问题的答案空间都以NCP/PES的rumric而不是免费形式的临床意见为界.

blocks.en: Subjectivity and Inter-Annotator Agreement
blocks.zh: 主观性和通知人间协定

blocks.en: We do not claim that a single nutritionist’s annotation produces a unique gold answer for every case: clinically valid alternatives exist, particularly for the recommendation-style questions. Two design choices mitigate this. First, the NCP/PES guideline structurally constrains acceptable answers: a PES diagnosis (Question 4) must contain the three required components in the prescribed order, and a dietary-goals statement (Question 5) is bounded by the patient’s clinical condition and standard-of-care guidelines. Second, our experimental protocol uses metrics that are robust to clinically valid lexical variation: BERTScore, sentence-embedding cosine similarity, and the LLM-as-judge rubric of Section 6.5 explicitly do not penalize paraphrase, and the LLM judge scores factuality and clinical safety separately. Three caveats remain, the first now partly resolved by measurement rather than argument. (i) A conventional inter-annotator κ \kappa over the references is undefined here, because each report was answered by a single nutritionist; in its place we report the three-rater re-scoring study and the gold-answer audit of Section 4 and Appendix E , which give an expert-agreement ceiling (quadratic κ = 0.780 \kappa=0.780 factuality, 0.752 0.752 completeness, 0.160 0.160 safety) and a direct reference-error estimate ( 6 % 6\% by explicit flag, 10 % 10\% including free-text criticism). Extending that audit beyond 50 50 units, and to the training split, remains future work. (ii) Two of the three raters also wrote references, so the audit is not fully independent: only the RD took no part in writing the answers. (iii) The three-nutritionist pipeline is one specific protocol; reproducing this dataset under a parallel multi-annotator protocol would establish a strict upper bound on what single-annotator authoring can recover, and because each nutritionist wrote answers for different reports, author effects cannot be separated from report effects.
blocks.zh: 我们并不声称一个营养学家的注解能为每个案例提供独特的金子答案:临床上有效的替代品存在,特别是推荐式的问题。 两个设计选择缓解了这种情况。 首先,NCP/PES准则在结构上限制了可接受的答案:PES诊断(问题4)必须按规定的顺序包含三个必要的组成部分,饮食目标说明(问题5)以病人的临床状况和护理标准准则为条件。 第二,我们的实验协议使用强力到临床上有效的词典变化的度量衡:BERTScore,句子-嵌入共心相似性,以及6.5节的LLM-as-judge主语明确不惩罚释义,LLM法官分别评分事实质量和临床安全性. 仍有三个告诫,第一个是目前通过衡量而不是通过辩论部分解决的。 (i) 这里没有定义一个常规的“\kappa”,因为每份报告都由一位营养学家回答;我们报告三个方的重新评分研究和对第4节和附录E的金子解答审计,它们规定了专家协议的上限(夸大方=0.780\kappa=0.780事实质量、0.752 0.752完整性、0.160 0.160安全性)和直接的参考-error估计(6% 6+%通过明确旗帜,10% 10+%包括自由文本批评)。 将审计范围扩大到50个以上单位,以及将培训工作分开,仍然是今后的工作。 (二)三个评分者中有两个还写了参考文献,因此审计不完全独立:只有RD没有参与写答案. (三)三营养素管道是一个具体的协议;在平行的多注释人协议下复制这个数据集将会对单注释人写作者可以恢复的是什么建立严格的上限,由于每个营养主义者为不同的报告写作答案,所以作者效应不能与报告效果分开.

blocks.en: Question-Context Pairing: Six-Stage Matching
blocks.zh: 问答对齐:六阶对齐

blocks.en: Unlike SQuAD-style datasets in which an annotator writes both the question and a span within a fixed passage, IndoNutriQA’s context field is algorithmically located from the source clinical report after the answer has been authored. For each (report, question, answer) triple we assign the context field to the chunk in which the authored answer is best located, using a six-stage matching strategy applied in order: (1) exact substring match; (2) case-insensitive match; (3) whitespace-normalized match (collapsing multi-space and newline variants); (4) case-insensitive whitespace-normalized match; (5) punctuation-stripped match; (6) sliding-window fragment matching with progressively shorter prefixes of the answer ( { 150,100 , 80 , 60 , 40 , 30 , 20 } \{150,100,80,60,40,30,20\} characters). The character-level start position of the answer within the chunk is recorded as answer_start , supporting extractive-QA training under a SQuAD-compatible schema. Across the full 911 911 -pair release, the procedure locates a verified character-level position in 823 823 pairs ( 90.3 % 90.3\% ); the remaining 88 88 pairs ( 9.7 % 9.7\% ) are released with a non-negative chunk_index pointing to the most similar chunk but without a verified character-level answer_start , and are flagged in the released metadata so downstream users requiring strictly extractive-style supervision can filter on this column.
blocks.zh: 与SQAD风格的数据集不同,在SQAD中,一个注释者在固定通道内既写问题,又写一个跨度,IndoNutriQA的上下文领域在答案被写出后从源临床报告算法上定位. 对于每一个(报告,问题,答案),我们用一个六级匹配策略,将上下文字段指定为作者答案所在的最佳区块,其顺序是:(1) 精确的子字符串匹配;(2) 大小写不敏感匹配;(3) 白空正常匹配(碰撞多空间和新线变体);(4) 大小写不敏感白空正常匹配;(5) punctuation - stripped匹配;(6) 滑窗碎片匹配,并逐步缩短答案的前缀({150100,80,60,40,30,20}}++150,100,80,60,40,30,20\}字符). 答案在块内的字符级起始位置记录为应答_启动,支持在SQAD-兼容的策略下进行采掘-QA训练. 在911-Pair版911全文中,该程序将一个经核实的字符级位置定位为823 823对(90.3%90.3\%);其余88对(9.7%9.7\%)发布时有一个非负块_index指向最相似的块,但没有经过核实的字符级答案_开始,并在发布后的元数据中标出,这样,要求严格采掘式监督的下游用户就可以在这个栏目上过滤。

blocks.en: Metric normalisation conventions. Exact match and token-F1 are computed after SQuAD-style normalisation (lowercasing, punctuation stripping, article removal, whitespace collapsing), whereas BLEU uses raw whitespace tokenisation and ROUGE uses rouge_score ’s internal tokenisation and stemming. BLEU is therefore punctuation-sensitive and reads systematically lower than F1 on the same predictions; because the convention is applied uniformly across systems, model rankings are unaffected. The SQuAD-derived normaliser also removes the English articles a, an, and the, which on Indonesian clinical text deletes the token A from nutrient names such as vitamin A; 67 67 of the 911 911 reference answers contain a standalone a. Since the same normaliser is applied to predictions and references alike F1 is essentially unaffected, but exact match cannot distinguish vitamin from vitamin A. Future releases of the evaluation script will drop the article-removal step.
blocks.zh: 计量正常化公约。 精确匹配和令牌-F1是在SQAD 风格的正常化(低价、平价剥离、删除文章、白空间崩溃)之后计算的,而BLEU 使用原始的白空间标记,ROUGE使用roge_score 的内部标记和终止。 因此,BLEU对振荡敏感,在同一预测中,其读数系统低于F1;由于公约在系统之间统一适用,模型排名不受影响。 SQAD派生的常态器也删除了印尼临床文本上删除维他命A等营养物名称的a,a,a的英文条款;911911参考答案中67个包含一个独立的a. 由于同样的常态性适用于预测,F1等参考物基本上没有受到影响,但精确匹配无法区分维生素A. 未来发布评价脚本将放弃删除文章的步骤.

Per-example inter-judge agreement between GPT-4o-mini and Claude Haiku 4.5 across the three rubric dimensions ( n = 2,879 n=2{,}879 paired judgements, pooled across all 22 22 model rows) is summarised in Table 10 ; Claude-judge model-level scores are reported in Table 11 .

blocks.en: Judge Self-Preference Analysis
blocks.zh: 法官自选分析

blocks.en: GPT-4o-mini serves as the primary judge while GPT-4o-mini and GPT-4o also appear as evaluated systems. We therefore test directly for self-preference. A raw comparison of the judge’s scores on OpenAI systems against its scores on other systems would confound self-preference with the fact that the OpenAI systems are genuinely stronger. We instead use a difference-in-differences design. For each of the 22 22 evaluated systems we compute the mean overall-rubric score under GPT-4o-mini minus the mean under Claude Haiku 4.5 4.5 , restricted to the examples both judges scored, so the per-system judge gap is a paired quantity from which true system quality, visible to both judges, has been differenced out. We then ask whether that gap is larger for systems sharing the judge’s provider than for the rest. Claude Haiku 4.5 4.5 is a valid control because no evaluated system comes from its provider, so it has no self to prefer.
blocks.zh: GPT-4o-mini担任主裁判,而GPT-4o-mini和GPT-4o也作为评价系统出现. 因此,我们直接检验自我偏爱。 将法官在OpenAI系统中的得分与其他系统的得分进行原始比较,会使法官自我偏爱与OpenAI系统真正更强大这一事实相混淆。 相反,我们采用了一种差异性设计。 对于22个被评价的系统,我们计算出GPT-4o-mini下的平均总体Rubric分数减去Claude Haiku4.54.5下的平均值,仅限于两位法官得分的例子,因此,每个系统法官的差距是一对数量,而两位法官都可以看到真正的系统质量。 然后,我们问,共用法官提供者的系统是否比其他系统的差距更大。 Claude Haiku 4.5是一个有效的控制,因为任何被评价的系统都没有来自其提供者,所以它没有自我选择.

blocks.en: Table 13 reports the result. GPT-4o-mini is uniformly more lenient than Claude Haiku 4.5 4.5 ( + 0.186 +0.186 rubric points on non-OpenAI systems alone), but the additional leniency it extends to its own provider is + 0.125 +0.125 points on the overall score and is not statistically distinguishable from zero (permutation p = 0.34 p=0.34 ). The per-dimension breakdown argues further against a systematic mechanism: the estimated effect is positive on factuality ( + 0.456 +0.456 , p = 0.103 p=0.103 ) but negative on safety ( − 0.259 -0.259 , p = 0.092 p=0.092 ), i.e. the judge is if anything harsher on its own provider’s safety. A genuine self-preference bias would push consistently in one direction. Across the eight tests reported, none is significant at a Bonferroni-corrected threshold ( α = 0.00625 \alpha=0.00625 ).
blocks.zh: 表13报告了结果。 GPT-4o-mini比克劳德·海库4.54.5(仅非OpenAI系统中的+0.186+0.186 rubric points)一致的宽大度,但其对自身提供者的额外宽大度在总分上为+0.125+0.125,在统计学上与零没有区别(permutation p=0.34 p=0.34). 分解法进一步反对系统机制:估计效果对事实性有利(+0.456+0.456,p=0.103p=0.103),但对安全性不利(−0.259-0.259,p=0.092p=0.092),即法官对其本身提供者的安全是否更严厉。 真正的自我偏爱偏见将始终朝一个方向推进。 在所报告的8项试验中,在Bonferroni修正阈值(α = 0.00625\alpha = 0.00625)方面,没有一项试验是重大的。

blocks.en: Two caveats. First, with only four same-provider systems the test is underpowered; we can report that no self-preference effect is detectable, not that none exists. Second, the design detects provider-level favouritism, not a stylistic prior that both judges might share; the expert-rater calibration of Appendix E addresses the latter by anchoring both judges to human clinical judgement.
blocks.zh: 二劝戒. 首先,只有四个相同的供应系统,测试能力不足;我们可以报告,没有可察觉的自我偏好效应,而不是不存在。 其次,设计检测出提供者一级的偏袒,而不是两种法官可能共享的先行模式;附录E的专家-评测者通过将两种法官置于人类临床判断之上来解决后者。

blocks.en: Expert-Rater Calibration of the LLM Judge
blocks.zh: LLM法官的专家 -- -- 机校准

blocks.en: To anchor the LLM-as-judge rubric to human clinical judgement, three expert raters (one Registered Dietitian, two nutritionists) independently re-scored a stratified sample of model outputs. We drew 50 50 (test example, system output) units stratified by question category (factual / inferential / recommendation) crossed with system quality tier, so that the sample spans the full answer-quality range; the 50 50 units cover 50 50 distinct test examples and all 20 20 source reports in the test split, and were produced by 20 20 of the 22 22 evaluated systems. Each rater scored every unit on the same three-dimension, 1 1 – 5 5 rubric the LLM judge uses (factuality, completeness, clinical safety), blind to system identity and to the judges’ scores, working from the question, the reference answer, the candidate answer, and the patient’s diagnosis and anthropometric assessment. Stratification was on question category and aggregate system quality, never on the per-unit judge score, so the sample does not condition on the quantity being estimated.
blocks.zh: 为了将LLM-as-judge主题定位为人类临床判断,三名专家评分员(一名注册饮食师,两名营养师)独立重新评分了一个分级的模型产出样本。 我们绘制了50个单元(测试实例,系统输出),按问题类别(事实/推论/建议)进行分级,与系统质量等级交叉,以便样本跨越整个答题质量范围;50个单元涵盖50个不同的测试实例和测试分拆中的所有20个来源报告,由22个评估系统中的20个系统编写。 每个评分员在同一个三分制上给每个单位打分,1比1,5比5,LLM法官使用(事实性,完整性,临床安全),盲目系统身份和评分,从问题开始,参考答案,候选答案,以及病人的诊断和人体测量评估. 分级涉及问题类别和综合系统质量,从未涉及每个单位法官的分数,因此样本并不取决于估计的数量。

blocks.en: Table 12 (top) reports quadratic-weighted Cohen’s κ \kappa for the reference rater pair and Krippendorff’s ordinal α \alpha across all three. Factuality ( κ = 0.780 \kappa=0.780 , α = 0.592 \alpha=0.592 ) and completeness ( κ = 0.752 \kappa=0.752 , α = 0.712 \alpha=0.712 ) reach substantial agreement. Clinical safety does not ( κ = 0.160 \kappa=0.160 , α = 0.250 \alpha=0.250 ): the three raters’ mean safety scores are 3.88 3.88 , 4.66 4.66 , and 2.94 2.94 , a spread of 1.72 1.72 rubric points between the most and least lenient. Safety, as operationalised by this rubric, is therefore not a dimension on which raters themselves converge, and any judge-vs-human safety comparison inherits that instability.
blocks.zh: 表12(顶部)报告Cohen的四重方正方正方正辛醇/水分配系数, 事实(^ 0.780\kappa=0.780,α=0.592\alpha=0.592)和完整性(^ 0.752\kappa=0.752,α=0.712\alpha=0.712)达成实质性协议. 临床安全没有(ob = 0.160\kappa= 0.160, α = 0.250\alpha= 0.250): 三种评分的平均安全分数为3.88 3.88, 4.66 4.66, 2.94 2.94, 差幅为1.72 1.72 卢布,在最宽和最宽之间。 因此,如本标题所述,安全并不是评估者本身趋同的一个方面,任何法官-法官-人的安全比较都会继承这种不稳定。

blocks.en: Table 12 (middle) compares each judge against the rater consensus (per-dimension mean, rounded half up). The key comparison is vertical: on factuality, GPT-4o-mini agrees with the rater consensus at κ = 0.705 \kappa=0.705 against an inter-rater ceiling of 0.780 0.780 , and on completeness at 0.623 0.623 against a ceiling of 0.752 0.752 ; the confidence intervals overlap substantially in both cases. On these two dimensions the judge is therefore about as close to a rater as raters are to each other, which is the strongest validation available for a rubric of this kind. Agreement is highest on the recommendation questions (factuality κ = 0.918 \kappa=0.918 ) and weakest on the short-span factual ones ( 0.478 0.478 ), mirroring the difficulty ordering in Section 6.7 .
blocks.zh: 表12(中间)将每位法官与评分者共识进行比较(每分级平均值,四舍五入)。 关键比较是纵向的:在事实性方面,GPT-4o-mini同意对0.705\kappa=0.705的评分一致,对0.7800.780的评分上限,对0.6230.623的评分完全一致,对0.7520.752的评分上限,置信间隔在两种情况下都大相径庭。 因此在这两个维度上,法官与评分者差不多接近于一个评分者,这是对此类评分最有力的验证。 就建议问题(实际性为0.918\kappa=0.918)和短期事实问题(0.478 0.478)达成一致意见最多,反映了第6.7节中顺序的困难。

blocks.en: Safety is the exception on both axes. Judge-vs-consensus κ \kappa is 0.133 0.133 for GPT-4o-mini and 0.480 0.480 for Claude Haiku 4.5, and the leniency column shows why: GPT-4o-mini scores safety + 1.14 +1.14 rubric points above the rater consensus (mean 4.92 4.92 against 3.78 3.78 ), essentially saturating the scale, and Claude + 0.58 +0.58 . Both judges systematically overstate the clinical safety of model output. Two further asymmetries are worth recording. GPT-4o-mini is not uniformly lenient: on the factual questions it is stricter than the raters ( − 0.82 -0.82 on factuality). Claude Haiku 4.5 systematically under-scores completeness ( − 0.78 -0.78 pooled). We therefore recommend that the safety dimension of this rubric be treated as unvalidated, that Claude Haiku 4.5 be preferred where a safety signal is needed ( κ = 0.480 \kappa=0.480 vs 0.133 0.133 ), and that neither judge’s absolute safety score be read as a clinical guarantee.
blocks.zh: 安全是两轴上的例外. Judge-vs-Consensus $\kappa为GPT-4-mini0.1330.133,Claude Haiku 4.50.4800.48,宽大处理栏显示原因:GPT-4-mini的得分安全性+1.14+1.14 rubric 积分高于评分共识(平均4.92 4.92对3.78 3.78),基本饱和比分,Claude+0.58+0.58. 两位法官系统地夸大了模型产出的临床安全性。 还有两个不对称现象值得记录。 GPT-4o-mini并非统一宽松:在事实问题上,它比评分者更为严格(-0.82-0.82)。 Claude Haiku 4.5系统分数不足的完整性(− 0.78-0.78集合)。 因此,我们建议将这个标题的安全方面视为未验证,在需要安全信号的地方优先使用Claude Haiku 4.5(ob = 0.480\kappa= 0.480 vs 0.133 0.133),而且法官的绝对安全分数都不应被视为临床保证。

blocks.en: Raters could additionally flag units whose reference answer they judged incorrect or contestable. Three of 50 50 units were flagged ( 6 % 6\% ), one of them by two raters independently; the flagged cases concern macronutrient percentage distributions that do not sum to 100 % 100\% , a mid-upper-arm-circumference cut-off, and a neonatal protein prescription. This is a direct estimate of gold-answer error in the test split and is consistent with the single-annotator caveat recorded in the Limitations; the flagged items are released with the benchmark so that users can exclude or re-adjudicate them.
blocks.zh: 鼠标还可以标出其参考答案不正确或有争议的单位。 50个单位中有3个单位被标注(6% 6 +%),其中1个单位由两个评估员独立标注;标注的案例涉及宏观营养百分比的分布,不等于100% 100 +% , 中上臂循环切除,以及新生儿蛋白质处方。 这是对测试拆分中的金答错误的直接估计,符合"限制"中记录的单标注符警告;标注项随基准释放,以便用户可以排除或重新判断.

blocks.en: Table 12: Expert-rater calibration of the LLM-as-judge rubric on 50 50 stratified units. Inter-rater κ \kappa is the reference pair; Krippendorff’s ordinal α \alpha pools all three raters. Judge agreement on factuality and completeness approaches the inter-rater ceiling, whereas safety agreement is low and both judges score safety substantially above the rater consensus.
blocks.zh: 表12:50个分级单元的LLM-as-judge主标的专家评分。 校对:Soup 法官关于事实质量和完整性的协议接近判决间上限,而安全协议很低,两位法官的安全性都大大高于判决间共识。

blocks.en: Finally, the choice of judge does not materially reorder the leaderboard (Spearman ρ = 0.916 \rho=0.916 between the two judges’ system rankings), and the substantive conclusion, that closed-source models lead the clinical rubric while open-source models lead the similarity axes, holds under both judges. The single rank that does move is the top position itself: GPT-4o-mini leads under its own family’s judge ( 4.37 4.37 ) whereas GPT-4o leads under Claude ( 4.15 4.15 ). We therefore report the rubric leader as a top tier rather than a single winner.
blocks.zh: 最后,法官的选择并没有在实质上重排领导板(Spearman à = 0.916\rho=0.916在两位法官的系统排名之间),而实质性结论是,封闭源模型领导临床主题,而开源模型领导相似轴,在两个法官之下都持有. 而GPT-4o-mini则在克劳德(4. 15 4. 15. 因此,我们把名义上的领导者称为最高层,而不是单一的赢家。

blocks.en: Table 13: Judge self-preference test. “Judge gap” is the per-system mean score under GPT-4o-mini minus the mean under Claude Haiku 4.5 4.5 on commonly scored examples; positive values mean GPT-4o-mini is more lenient. “Same prov.” groups the four systems sharing the judge’s provider (GPT-4o-mini and GPT-4o, zero- and five-shot). DiD is the difference-in-differences estimate of self-preference; p p is a two-sided permutation test over 20,000 20{,}000 relabellings. No dimension shows a significant effect, and the factuality and safety estimates carry opposite signs.
blocks.zh: 表13:法官自选考试。 “法官差距”是指GPT-4-mini下的每个系统平均分数减去Claude Haiku 4.5-4.5对常见得分例子的平均值;正值表示GPT-4-mini更宽大。 " 同一prov " 将共享法官提供者的四个系统(GPT-4o-mini和GPT-4o、0-和5-shot)分组。 DiD是自我偏爱的偏差估计;p是一个双侧倾斜测试,超过20,000 20{,}000重贴标签. 没有维度显示显著影响,而事实和安全估计带有相反的迹象。

blocks.en: Appendix F Human Error Analysis Details
blocks.zh: 附录F 人类错误分析细节

blocks.en: The nine categories of Table 14 were obtained by open-coding the 53 53 free-text notes the three expert raters left during the calibration study of Appendix E , then re-applying the finalised codebook to every note from scratch. No taxonomy was shown to the annotators, so error identification is theirs and unprompted; the coding is ours. A note may carry several codes (a rater often names an omission and a format violation in one sentence), so codes sum to more than 53 53 .
blocks.zh: 表14的9个类别是通过开放编码获得的53个53个自由文本注释,这些注释是附录E的校准研究中留下的3个专家评分符,然后从头到尾将定稿的编码本重新应用于每个注释。 没有向注释者展示分类学,所以错误识别是他们的,并且没有发生;编码是我们的。 注释可能包含多个代码(一个评分器常常将遗漏和格式违反记为一句话),所以代码总和超过53 53.

blocks.en: Table 14 reports, for each category, the number and percentage of the 50 50 units in which it occurs; a unit may carry several categories, so the percentages sum to more than 100 % 100\% . “Mean rater score” is the raters’ own 1 1 – 5 5 rating (factuality, completeness, safety) on the units carrying that category. Two categories have no counterpart in the LLM-judged taxonomy of Table 17 : NCP/PES violation, and unsupported addition, for which the judge’s hallucination label did not flag the units.
blocks.zh: 表14报告每个类别50个单位的数目和百分比;一个单位可能包含多个类别,因此,百分比总额超过100%。 " 计量员分数 " 是计量员在持有该类别的单位中自己的11至5分(实际性、完整性、安全性)。 有两个类别在LLM判断的表17分类法中没有对应:NCP/PES违规和无支持的添加,法官的幻觉标签没有标注这些单位。

blocks.en: Notes were optional, and the rate differs sharply by rater ( 36 36 , 9 9 , and 8 8 notes), so each count is a lower bound on prevalence and not an error rate; the category ordering is more reliable than the absolute percentages. The 50 50 units span 20 20 systems, so the analysis characterises failure modes of the evaluated pool rather than of any one system. Because the raters saw the patient’s diagnosis and anthropometric assessment while the judge saw only reference and candidate, part of the judge-vs-human gap on unsupported content is an information gap rather than a reasoning gap, which is itself an argument for giving judges the record.
blocks.zh: 音符是可选的,并且率因率(36 36,9 9,8 8 个音符)而大相径庭,所以每个音符都是对流行程度的下限,而不是误差率;分类顺序比绝对百分比更可靠. 50个单元跨越20个系统,因此分析将被评价的集合而不是任何一个系统的故障模式定性. 因为评测员看到病人的诊断和人体测量评估,而法官只看到参考和候选人,所以法官-vs-人对无支持内容的部分差距是信息差距,而不是推理差距,而推理差距本身就是给法官提供记录的理由.

blocks.en: Numeric errors concentrate on the recommendation questions, which carry prescription arithmetic. And degenerate output (repetition, or report boilerplate and table markup leaking into the answer) still draws high rubric scores ( 4.40 / 4.20 / 4.40 4.40/4.20/4.40 ): the raters noted the defect in prose but did not treat it as a clinical error, which is a rubric-design gap rather than a model behaviour.

blocks.zh: 分类学错误

blocks.en: Table 17 classifies each model’s outputs on a sampled subset of 50 50 test examples into six categories (correct, partial, wrong span, terminology mismatch, hallucination, and noise), assigned by an LLM judge (GPT-4o-mini). This qualitative view complements the aggregate metrics in Section 6.2 by revealing how models fail rather than only how much. Two patterns stand out. First, the fine-tuned extractive baselines are dominated by noise ( 52 52 – 76 % 76\% ), reflecting empty or malformed span predictions, whereas the 5 5 -shot LLMs convert almost all of these into partial answers that capture some but not all of the reference content. Second, and most importantly, the human error analysis of Section 6.8 shows that the judge’s hallucination label cannot be relied on: raters reading the same class of output flagged unsupported additions in 10 % 10\% of audited units, including two that assert a clinical trend the patient record does not support and that the judge scored 4 4 on factuality. We therefore draw no conclusion about fabrication rates; under-answering is the dominant failure on both the judge’s and the raters’ accounts.
blocks.zh: 表17将每个模型的产出按50个测试实例的抽样子集归为六个类别(正确、部分、错误的跨度、术语不匹配、幻觉和噪音),由LLM法官(GPT-4o-mini)指定。 这种定性观点补充了第6.2节的汇总衡量标准,揭示了模型如何失败,而不是仅仅失败了多少。 两种模式突出. 首先,微调的采掘基线以噪音为主(52 52 — — 76 % 76 — — — ),反映了空洞的或畸形的跨度预测,而5 5镜头的LLMs则将几乎所有这些都转化为部分的答案,捕捉到部分但并非全部的参考内容. 其次,最重要的是,第6.8节的人为错误分析显示,法官的幻觉标签是不能依赖的:在10%的被审计单位中读取同一类产出的评级者标注了不支持的附加值,包括两个坚持病人记录不支持的临床趋势,法官在事实性上得分4 4。 因此,我们没有得出关于捏造率的结论;不足回答是法官和评估者账户的主要失败。
